properties.headline: 周威烈王命韩、赵、魏为诸侯（三家分晋）
properties.headline_en: King Weilie of Zhou recognizes Wei, Zhao, and Han as feudal lords (Partition of Jin)

properties.headline: 周安王册命田和为齐侯，田氏代齐，七雄形成
properties.headline_en: Tian He recognized as Marquis of Qi (Tian Usurpation), forming the Seven Warring States

properties.headline: 楚悼王任吴起变法强兵，南平百越、北并陈蔡、西却三晋
properties.headline_en: King Dao of Chu appoints Wu Qi to enact sweeping military reforms, expanding south and north

properties.headline: 韩哀侯攻灭郑国并迁都新郑；前376年三家废晋静公尽分晋地
properties.headline_en: Han conquers Zheng and moves its capital to Xinzheng after the Three Jins depose Duke Jing

properties.headline: 秦孝公任商鞅变法强秦；前350年迁都咸阳
properties.headline_en: Duke Xiao of Qin appoints Shang Yang for Legalist reforms; capital moves to Xianyang (350 BCE)

properties.headline: 桂陵之战：齐孙膑、田忌“围魏救赵”，大破庞涓
properties.headline_en: Battle of Guiling: Sun Bin and Tian Ji besiege Wei to rescue Zhao, defeating Pang Juan

properties.headline: 马陵之战孙膑射杀庞涓；商鞅收河西，魏迁大梁
properties.headline_en: Battle of Maling: Sun Bin slays Pang Juan; Shang Yang seizes Hexi as Wei moves to Daliang

properties.headline: 公孙衍发起“五国相王”，并促成五国合纵攻秦函谷关（前318年）
properties.headline_en: Gongsun Yan organizes the Five-State Alliance to march against Qin at Hangu Pass (318 BCE)

properties.headline: 秦司马错灭巴、蜀；前312年丹阳之战破楚取汉中
properties.headline_en: Qin conquers Shu and Ba (316 BCE) and seizes Hanzhong from Chu at Danyang (312 BCE)

properties.headline: 赵武灵王推行“胡服骑射”强兵，连年略中山，北破林胡楼烦辟云中九原
properties.headline_en: King Wuling of Zhao adopts cavalry archery, campaigns against Zhongshan, and opens Yunzhong

properties.headline: 楚怀王发兵灭越，尽取旧吴之地，东扩至海
properties.headline_en: King Huai of Chu annexes Yue, absorbing the former Wu heartland to the sea

properties.headline: 燕将秦开大破东胡却地千里，筑北长城置燕北五郡
properties.headline_en: Yan general Qin Kai routs the Donghu, builds the Northern Wall, and sets five commanderies

properties.headline: 赵惠文王彻底攻灭中山国；齐、韩、魏三国合纵攻秦，败秦军于函谷关
properties.headline_en: Zhao completes the conquest of Zhongshan; Qi, Han, and Wei coalition defeats Qin at Hangu Pass

properties.headline: 齐湣王灭宋，齐楚魏三分宋地（魏得商丘、楚得彭城、齐得定陶）
properties.headline_en: King Min of Qi annexes Song; Qi, Chu, and Wei partition its territory

properties.headline: 燕昭王拜乐毅统五国联军破齐，连下七十余城
properties.headline_en: Yan general Yue Yi leads a five-state coalition to crush Qi, capturing over 70 cities

properties.headline: 即墨之战：齐将田单摆“火牛阵”大破燕军，收复七十余城
properties.headline_en: Siege of Jimo: Qi general Tian Dan unleashes flaming oxen to rout Yan and retake 70 cities

properties.headline: 秦白起拔楚都郢置南郡，楚迁都于陈，屈原自沉汨罗江
properties.headline_en: Qin general Bai Qi captures Chu capital Ying; Chu moves to Chen as Qu Yuan drowns in the Miluo

properties.headline: 秦宣太后诱杀义渠戎王于甘泉宫，起兵灭义渠，置陇西、北地、上郡
properties.headline_en: Queen Dowager Xuan slays the Yiqu king at Ganquan, annexing Yiqu and setting 3 commanderies

properties.headline: 长平之战：白起坑杀赵卒四十万，六国难独抗秦
properties.headline_en: Battle of Changping: Bai Qi annihilates 400,000 Zhao troops, breaking Zhao’s military power

properties.headline: 邯郸之战：魏信陵君“窃符救赵”合楚春申君大破秦军
properties.headline_en: Relief of Handan: Lord Xinling seizes the tiger tally to aid Zhao and rout Qin with Chu

properties.headline: 秦灭西周国迁九鼎；蜀守李冰修筑都江堰
properties.headline_en: Qin extinguishes Western Zhou and seizes the Nine Tripods; Li Bing builds Dujiangyan

properties.headline: 楚考烈王伐灭鲁国迁鲁顷公于莒；秦吕不韦灭东周置三川郡
properties.headline_en: King Kaolie of Chu annexes Lu; Qin extinguishes Eastern Zhou and sets Sanchuan Commandery

properties.headline: 蒙骜攻赵取晋阳等三十七城，秦置太原郡
properties.headline_en: Meng Ao takes Jinyang and 36 more Zhao towns; Qin establishes Taiyuan Commandery

properties.headline: 韩水工郑国入秦开凿三百里“郑国渠”，关中自此成沃野
properties.headline_en: Hydraulic engineer Zheng Guo builds the 300-li Zheng Guo Canal, turning Guanzhong fertile

properties.headline: 蒙骜攻魏取二十城初置东郡，秦地东接齐境
properties.headline_en: Meng Ao seizes twenty Wei towns and founds Dongjun, pushing Qin's border east to Qi

properties.headline: 五国最后合纵攻秦败于蕞；楚畏秦自陈东迁寿春
properties.headline_en: Final five-state coalition against Qin fails at Zui; Chu moves its capital east to Shouchun

properties.headline: 秦王政亲政，平嫪毐、罢吕不韦，部署灭六国方略
properties.headline_en: King Zheng of Qin assumes rule, crushes Lao Ai, ousts Lü Buwei, and plans unification

properties.headline: 王翦、桓齮攻赵邺城取九城，拉开秦灭六国序幕
properties.headline_en: Wang Jian and Huan Yi take nine cities around Ye, opening Qin’s wars of unification

properties.headline: 秦灭韩：内史腾急袭新郑俘韩王安，置颍川郡
properties.headline_en: Conquest of Han: Qin Governor Teng captures King An at Xinzheng and sets Yingchuan Commandery

properties.headline: 秦灭赵：王翦克邯郸俘赵王迁，公子嘉奔代自立
properties.headline_en: Conquest of Zhao: Wang Jian captures Handan and King Qian; Prince Jia flees to proclaim Dai

properties.headline: 荆轲刺秦不中；王翦破燕拔蓟城，燕王喜走辽东
properties.headline_en: After Jing Ke’s failed assassination, Wang Jian captures Jicheng; King Xi flees to Liaodong

properties.headline: 秦灭魏：王贲引河沟水灌大梁，魏王假降，魏亡
properties.headline_en: Conquest of Wei: Wang Ben floods Daliang with Yellow River waters; King Jia surrenders

properties.headline: 秦灭楚：王翦统军六十万斩项燕、克寿春俘楚王
properties.headline_en: Conquest of Chu: Wang Jian leads 600,000 troops to defeat Xiang Yan and capture Shouchun

properties.headline: 王贲灭燕与代，王翦定江南置会稽郡，唯余齐国
properties.headline_en: Wang Ben conquers Yan and Dai while Wang Jian pacifies Jiangnan; only Qi remains

properties.headline: 王贲受齐王建降，秦王嬴政统一六国称始皇帝，行郡县、书同文车同轨
properties.headline_en: Wang Ben takes Qi's surrender; First Emperor unifies China with commanderies and one script

properties.headline: 蒙恬北击匈奴，收复河套，连接长城
properties.headline_en: Meng Tian drives the Xiongnu from the Ordos Loop and links the Great Wall

properties.headline: 秦军开凿灵渠通湘漓，平定岭南置桂林、象、南海三郡
properties.headline_en: First Emperor digs the Lingqu Canal and pacifies Lingnan, founding Guilin, Xiang, and Nanhai

properties.headline: 秦始皇采李斯议下“焚书令”，次年于咸阳坑杀方士儒生
properties.headline_en: First Emperor decrees the Burning of Books on Li Si advice, executing scholars next year

properties.headline: 蒙恬奉诏修筑秦直道（咸阳至九原）
properties.headline_en: First Emperor orders Meng Tian to build the 700 km Qin Direct Road from Xianyang to Jiuyuan

properties.headline: 沙丘政变：始皇崩于沙丘，赵高李斯矫诏杀扶苏立胡亥
properties.headline_en: Shaqiu Coup: First Emperor dies; Zhao Gao and Li Si forge an edict to enthrone Huhai

properties.headline: 陈胜吴广大泽乡起义建张楚；武臣、韩广、田儋相继复立赵、燕、齐
properties.headline_en: Chen Sheng & Wu Guang rise at Dazexiang; nobles restore the kingdoms of Zhao, Yan, and Qi

properties.headline: 项羽巨鹿之战破釜沉舟；南海尉赵佗绝秦道并桂林、象郡据岭南自立
properties.headline_en: Xiang Yu crushes Qin at Julu; Nanhai official Zhao Tuo unites Lingnan as autonomous Nanyue

properties.headline: 子婴降刘邦，秦亡；鸿门宴后项羽分封十八诸侯，楚汉争霸开启
properties.headline_en: Ziying yields to Liu Bang and Qin falls; Xiang Yu holds Hongmen Feast and enfeoffs 18 Kingdoms

properties.headline: 韩信于井陉背水一战灭赵，楚汉两军于荥阳、成皋持久相持
properties.headline_en: Han Xin destroys the Zhao army at Jingxing Pass while Liu Bang and Xiang Yu clash at Xingyang

properties.headline: 楚汉久持后“鸿沟议和”中分天下，刘邦旋毁约东追项羽
properties.headline_en: After a long stalemate, the Hong Canal Pact divides the realm before Liu Bang pursues Xiang Yu

properties.headline: 韩信等垓下十面埋伏灭项羽，汉高祖刘邦称帝定都长安
properties.headline_en: Han Xin and Liu Bang defeat Xiang Yu at Gaixia; Liu Bang ascends as Emperor Gaozu of Western Han

properties.headline: 汉高祖亲征匈奴困于白登，汉初遂行和亲之策
properties.headline_en: Emperor Gaozu is besieged at Baideng; early Han adopts the Heqin marriage-alliance policy

properties.headline: 周勃、陈平诛灭诸吕迎立汉文帝，开启休养生息之政
properties.headline_en: Zhou Bo and Chen Ping eliminate the Lü clan and enthrone Emperor Wen of Han

properties.headline: 汉文帝废除肉刑、免收全国田租，与景帝轻徭薄赋共创“文景之治”
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wen abolishes corporal punishment and land taxes, ushering in the Rule of Wen and Jing

properties.headline: 汉景帝削藩引发七国之乱，周亚夫三月平叛固集权
properties.headline_en: Emperor Jing's fief cuts spark the Rebellion of the Seven States; Zhou Yafu crushes the revolt

properties.headline: 张骞出使西域，凿空丝绸之路
properties.headline_en: Zhang Qian sets out for the Western Regions, opening the Silk Road

properties.headline: 汉武帝采董仲舒策独尊儒术，兴太学、初令郡国察举孝廉
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu elevates Confucianism, founds the Academy, and begins Filial-Incorrupt selection

properties.headline: 马邑之谋：汉武帝纳王恢策于马邑设伏诱击单于未果，汉匈全面战争爆发
properties.headline_en: Mayi Ambush: Emperor Wu sets a trap for the Xiongnu Chanyu at Mayi, sparking full-scale war

properties.headline: 卫青收复河套置朔方郡；主父偃献《推恩令》削弱诸侯
properties.headline_en: Wei Qing recovers the Ordos Loop for Shuofang Commandery; Decree of Extended Grace curbs princes

properties.headline: 霍去病两次河西之战受降浑邪王，初置武威、酒泉郡
properties.headline_en: Huo Qubing’s Hexi campaigns; Wuwei and Jiuquan commanderies founded

properties.headline: 漠北之战，卫青破单于、霍去病封狼居胥
properties.headline_en: Mobei Campaign; Wei Qing & Huo Qubing rout the Xiongnu

properties.headline: 汉武帝改铸五铢钱、推行盐铁官营，继行均输平准，财权收归中央
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu mints five-zhu coins, monopolizes salt and iron, and adds price stabilization

properties.headline: 路博德、杨仆平定南越设九郡；分河西置张掖、敦煌郡
properties.headline_en: Conquest of Nanyue (nine commanderies); Zhangye and Dunhuang founded

properties.headline: 汉武帝灭闽越国迁其民于江淮，并于海南岛置珠崖、儋耳二郡
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu conquers Minyue and establishes Zhuya and Dan'er commanderies on Hainan Island
properties.site: 东冶 · 珠崖（福州 · 海口）

properties.headline: 汉武帝发兵平西南夷，滇王降汉，置益州郡赐金印
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu pacifies the Southwestern Yi; King of Dian submits and Yizhou Commandery is set

properties.headline: 汉军攻灭卫氏朝鲜，设乐浪、玄菟、真番、临屯四郡
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu conquers Wiman Joseon and establishes Lelang, Xuantu, and two other commanderies

properties.headline: 贰师将军李广利伐大宛，丝路昆仑北路畅通
properties.headline_en: Li Guangli's Dayuan campaign secures the Southern Tarim Silk Road

properties.headline: 巫蛊之祸太子刘据兵败湖县自尽；太史令司马迁撰成《史记》
properties.headline_en: Witchcraft Crisis drives Prince Liu Ju to suicide; Sima Qian completes the Shiji chronicle

properties.headline: 武帝下轮台罪己诏，转向与民休息
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu issues the Luntai Edict of Repentance

properties.headline: 苏武持节十九载白发归汉；汉昭帝召集盐铁会议辩论国策
properties.headline_en: Su Wu returns after 19 years in captivity; Emperor Zhao convenes the Salt and Iron Debate

properties.headline: 大将军霍光废昌邑王刘贺，迎立汉宣帝开启昭宣中兴
properties.headline_en: Regent Huo Guang deposes Liu He after 27 days and enthrones Emperor Xuan (Zhaoxuan Restoration)

properties.headline: 赵充国率军平定河湟先零诸羌，首创河湟军屯并置破羌县
properties.headline_en: General Zhao Chongguo pacifies the Qiang in Hehuang and pioneers frontier military farms
properties.site: 临羌 · 湟水（青海西宁）

properties.headline: 汉廷设西域都护府（郑吉首任），西域正式纳入版图
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xuan establishes the Protectorate of the Western Regions under Zheng Ji at Wulei

properties.headline: 呼韩邪单于入长安朝觐，汉宣帝画麒麟阁十一功臣
properties.headline_en: Chanyu Huhanye pays homage at Chang'an; Emperor Xuan honors 11 ministers in the Qilin Pavilion

properties.headline: 陈汤矫制发兵远征康居斩郅支单于，“犯强汉者虽远必诛”
properties.headline_en: Chen Tang storms Zhizhi in Kangju and slays Zhizhi Chanyu, proclaiming Han's reach afar

properties.headline: 昭君出塞，呼韩邪单于入朝和亲
properties.headline_en: Wang Zhaojun marries Xiongnu Chanyu Huhanye

properties.headline: 西域都护段会宗复入乌孙平定内乱，安辑葱岭以西诸国
properties.headline_en: Protector-General Duan Huizong pacifies strife in Wusun and stabilizes the Pamir states

properties.headline: 汉成帝改置三公；王莽任大司马，王氏外戚掌权
properties.headline_en: Emperor Cheng establishes Three Excellencies; Wang Mang becomes Grand Marshal

properties.headline: 王莽受封安汉公专擅朝政，汉平帝崩后立孺子婴居摄称“假皇帝”
properties.headline_en: Made Duke of Anhan, Wang Mang seizes power and rules as Acting Emperor over Young Prince Ying

properties.headline: 外戚王莽迫孺子婴禅让，于未央宫即真天子位，改国号“新”，西汉亡
properties.headline_en: Regent Wang Mang forces Young Prince Ying to abdicate and proclaims the Xin dynasty, ending Han

properties.headline: 王莽推行王田、私属与五均六筦托古改制，四方民变渐起
properties.headline_en: Wang Mang enforces archaic land, currency, and monopoly reforms, sparking widespread unrest

properties.headline: 黄河于魏郡元城决口，禹贡北流故道断绝泛滥兖豫
properties.headline_en: Yellow River breaches at Yuancheng, ending the ancient northern course and flooding the east

properties.headline: 绿林军起于绿林山；次年樊崇起赤眉军于琅琊，新莽末年大起义爆发
properties.headline_en: Lülin rebels rise; Red Eyebrows follow in Langya as late-Xin peasant revolts spread

properties.headline: 绿林军拥汉宗室刘玄称更始帝；宗室刘秀昆阳大破莽军，入长安诛王莽
properties.headline_en: Lülin rebels crown Gengshi Emperor Liu Xuan; Liu Xiu routs Xin at Kunyang, ending Wang Mang

properties.headline: 更始帝刘玄入都长安；刘秀以大司马北渡独立经略河北，拔邯郸诛王郎
properties.headline_en: Gengshi Emperor enters Chang’an; Liu Xiu crosses north to pacify Hebei and slays Wang Lang

properties.headline: 赤眉军入长安覆灭更始政权；萧王刘秀于鄗城称帝兴复汉室，定都洛阳
properties.headline_en: Red Eyebrows topple Gengshi in Chang’an; Liu Xiu ascends at Haocheng and makes Luoyang capital

properties.headline: 吴汉攻克成都灭公孙述，光武帝刘秀统一全国
properties.headline_en: Wu Han takes Chengdu and destroys Gongsun Shu; Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) reunifies the empire

properties.headline: 光武帝下诏核查全国垦田与户口（度田），打击豪强隐匿田赋
properties.headline_en: Emperor Guangwu decrees an empire-wide land and household survey to curb estate tax evasion

properties.headline: 伏波将军马援南征交趾平二征起义，立铜柱定汉界
properties.headline_en: General Ma Yuan suppresses the Trưng sisters in Jiaozhi and erects bronze border pillars

properties.headline: 匈奴日逐王比南附东汉称呼韩邪单于，匈奴分裂为南北二部，驻美稷
properties.headline_en: Southern Xiongnu claimant Bi submits to Eastern Han at Meiji, splitting the Xiongnu in two

properties.headline: 汉明帝建白马寺，佛教正式传入洛阳
properties.headline_en: Emperor Ming founds White Horse Temple; Buddhism takes root

properties.headline: 王景发卒数十万修渠治河，形成千年安流“王景故道”
properties.headline_en: Wang Jing builds a 500-km Yellow River levee system, stabilizing its course for a millennium

properties.headline: 班超出使西域，重开丝路
properties.headline_en: Ban Chao sent to the Western Regions, reopening the Silk Road

properties.headline: 汉章帝亲临白虎观讲议五经同异，班固撰《白虎通义》与《汉书》
properties.headline_en: Emperor Zhang convenes the White Tiger Hall council; Ban Gu compiles the Book of Han

properties.headline: 窦宪破北匈奴于稽落山，登燕然山勒石记功
properties.headline_en: Dou Xian routs the Northern Xiongnu at Jiluo and carves a victory stele on Mt. Yanran

properties.headline: 金微山之战：耿夔大破北匈奴，北单于西遁
properties.headline_en: Geng Kui crushes the Northern Xiongnu at Mt. Jinwei (Altai) and the Chanyu flees west

properties.headline: 永元之隆：汉和帝联结郑众诛大将军窦宪，东汉达极盛
properties.headline_en: Prosperity of Yongyuan: Emperor He ousts Regent Dou Xian and brings Eastern Han to its zenith

properties.headline: 班超遣甘英出使大秦（罗马）
properties.headline_en: Ban Chao dispatches Gan Ying toward Daqin (Roman Empire)

properties.headline: 蔡伦奏进改进造纸术（蔡侯纸）
properties.headline_en: Imperial eunuch Cai Lun refines the papermaking process in Luoyang

properties.headline: 永初羌乱爆发席卷凉州，东汉罢西域都护
properties.headline_en: Qiang uprisings engulf Liangzhou as Han withdraws its Protectorate of the Western Regions

properties.headline: 班勇任西域长史屯兵柳中破北匈奴，复通西域
properties.headline_en: Ban Yong (son of Ban Chao) garrisons Liuzhong and defeats Northern Xiongnu, reopening Tarim

properties.headline: 张衡造候风地动仪与浑天仪
properties.headline_en: Zhang Heng invents the seismoscope and armillary sphere

properties.headline: 护羌校尉赵冲战殁，西羌大乱席卷关陇；汉顺帝崩，梁冀专权
properties.headline_en: Major Qiang rebellion sweeps Guanzhong and Longyou while Regent Liang Ji monopolizes power

properties.headline: 汉桓帝与单超等五宦官合谋诛灭梁冀外戚集团；段颎于陇右破羌
properties.headline_en: Emperor Huan and five eunuchs overthrow Regent Liang Ji while Duan Jiong crushes the Qiang

properties.headline: 党锢之祸：166、169年两兴党狱，清流名士遭禁锢诛戮
properties.headline_en: The Partisan Prohibitions of 166 and 169 ban and execute leading scholar-officials

properties.headline: 夏育、田晏、臧旻三路伐鲜卑大败，檀石槐称雄漠南
properties.headline_en: Three Han columns against the Xianbei are routed and Tanshihuai dominates the southern steppe
properties.site: 高柳 · 云中 · 雁门

properties.headline: 张角率太平道发起黄巾起义
properties.headline_en: Zhang Jue launches the Yellow Turban Rebellion across eight provinces

properties.headline: 何进召外兵谋诛宦官遇害，董卓入洛废少帝立献帝，次年焚洛阳西迁长安
properties.headline_en: Dong Zhuo seizes Luoyang, deposes Emperor Shao for Emperor Xian, and moves the capital

properties.headline: 孙策渡江创业平定江东；汉献帝自长安东归洛阳
properties.headline_en: Sun Ce crosses the Yangtze to conquer Jiangdong; Emperor Xian flees east from Chang'an

properties.headline: 曹操迎汉献帝都许，挟天子以令诸侯；始兴屯田
properties.headline_en: Cao Cao welcomes Emperor Xian to Xu (Xuchang) and establishes military-agricultural colonies

properties.headline: 下邳之战：曹操决泗、沂水灌城，擒杀吕布，尽取徐州
properties.headline_en: Battle of Xiapi: Cao Cao floods Xiapi with the Si and Yi rivers, capturing and executing Lu Bu

properties.headline: 官渡之战：曹操奇袭乌巢焚粮，大破袁绍主力；孙策遇刺，孙权继立
properties.headline_en: Battle of Guandu: Cao Cao burns Yuan Shao's supply depot at Wuchao; Sun Quan succeeds Sun Ce

properties.headline: 曹操引漳水围破邺城，定冀、青、幽、并四州，迁霸府于邺
properties.headline_en: Cao Cao captures Ye City and consolidates control over Hebei's four northern provinces

properties.headline: 刘备三顾茅庐请诸葛亮出山，定《隆中对》跨有荆益之策
properties.headline_en: Liu Bei makes three visits to Zhuge Liang at Longzhong, adopting the Longzhong Plan

properties.headline: 赤壁之战，孙刘联军破曹，刘备据有荆州
properties.headline_en: Battle of Red Cliffs: Sun-Liu alliance defeats Cao Cao; Liu Bei holds Jingzhou

properties.headline: 潼关之战：曹操渡渭离间大破马超、韩遂，平定关陇
properties.headline_en: Battle of Tong Pass: Cao Cao defeats Ma Chao and Han Sui to pacify Guanzhong

properties.headline: 刘备入成都迫降刘璋，跨有荆、益二州
properties.headline_en: Liu Bei enters Chengdu and receives Liu Zhang’s surrender, holding both Jingzhou and Yizhou

properties.headline: 曹操西征阳平关降汉中张鲁；孙刘湘水划界分荆州；张辽威震逍遥津
properties.headline_en: Cao Cao takes Hanzhong from Zhang Lu; Sun and Liu split Jingzhou; Zhang Liao holds Xiaoyao Ford
properties.site: 南郑 · 临湘 · 合肥

properties.headline: 曹操于邺城进爵“魏王”设天子旌旗，继封魏公加九锡后代汉基业成
properties.headline_en: Elevated to King of Wei at Ye after the Nine Bestowals, Cao Cao lays the foundation of Wei

properties.headline: 刘备于沔阳自立为汉中王；冬吕蒙白衣渡江袭荆州，关羽败亡
properties.headline_en: Liu Bei proclaims himself King of Hanzhong; in winter Lü Meng seizes Jingzhou and Guan Yu falls

properties.headline: 魏王曹操病逝；曹丕采陈群议行九品官人法，旋迫汉献帝禅让建曹魏
properties.headline_en: Cao Cao dies in Luoyang; Cao Pi enacts the Nine-Rank System and founds Cao Wei

properties.headline: 闻汉献帝遭废传言，刘备在成都称帝延续汉室正统，国号汉（蜀汉）
properties.headline_en: Hearing of Emperor Xian’s deposition, Liu Bei proclaims himself Emperor of Shu Han at Chengdu

properties.headline: 夷陵之战，陆逊火烧连营大破刘备
properties.headline_en: Battle of Yiling; Lu Xun defeats Liu Bei by fire attack

properties.headline: 刘备病逝永安白帝城，临终托孤于丞相诸葛亮
properties.headline_en: Liu Bei dies at White Emperor City in Yong'an, entrusting the state to Zhuge Liang

properties.headline: 诸葛亮南征孟获，平定南中
properties.headline_en: Zhuge Liang's Southern Campaign pacifies Nanzhong

properties.headline: 诸葛亮首次北伐，马谡失街亭
properties.headline_en: Zhuge Liang's First Northern Expedition; loss of Jieting

properties.headline: 吴王孙权于武昌称帝建国号吴，旋东迁建业，三国鼎立定型
properties.headline_en: Sun Quan proclaims himself Emperor of Wu at Wuchang and moves the capital to Jianye

properties.headline: 孙权遣卫温、诸葛直率万人航海至夷洲
properties.headline_en: Sun Quan dispatches Wei Wen and Zhuge Zhi by sea to Yizhou

properties.headline: 司马懿坚壁拒守百余日；诸葛亮病逝五丈原，蜀军退回汉中
properties.headline_en: Sima Yi holds firm for over 100 days; Zhuge Liang dies on Wuzhang Plains and Shu retreats

properties.headline: 司马懿远征辽东斩公孙渊，收复辽东与乐浪、带方
properties.headline_en: Sima Yi conquers Liaodong and executes Gongsun Yuan, recovering Lelang and Daifang

properties.headline: 兴势之战：王平据险拒退曹爽伐蜀大军；毌丘俭东征高句丽克丸都
properties.headline_en: Battle of Xingshi: Wang Ping repels Cao Shuang's invasion; Guanqiu Jian sacks Goguryeo's Wandu

properties.headline: 高平陵之变：司马懿趁曹爽扈帝谒陵闭城夺权，诛曹爽族党尽控曹魏朝政
properties.headline_en: Gaoping Tombs Incident: Sima Yi seizes Luoyang while Cao Shuang is away and takes control of Wei

properties.headline: 毌丘俭、文钦寿春起兵讨司马师败亡；姜维北伐洮西大破王经
properties.headline_en: Guanqiu Jian's Shouchun rebellion is crushed by Sima Shi; Jiang Wei routs Wang Jing at Taoxi

properties.headline: 甘露之变：魏帝曹髦率宿卫讨司马昭，于南阙下遇弑
properties.headline_en: Coup of Ganlu: Wei Emperor Cao Mao marches against Sima Zhao and is slain at the palace gate

properties.headline: 邓艾、钟会率魏军伐蜀，蜀汉亡
properties.headline_en: Wei generals Deng Ai and Zhong Hui conquer Shu Han at Chengdu

properties.headline: 钟会、姜维于成都构乱败亡；曹魏分益州置梁州，孙吴分交州置广州
properties.headline_en: Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei fall in the Chengdu mutiny; Wei creates Liangzhou, Wu creates Guangzhou

properties.headline: 晋王司马昭卒，子司马炎嗣位后迫魏元帝禅让称帝，建立西晋，曹魏亡
properties.headline_en: Following Sima Zhao’s death, Sima Yan forces the Wei emperor to abdicate and founds Western Jin

properties.headline: 西陵之战：陆抗围城打援大破晋将羊祜、杨肇，斩叛将步阐
properties.headline_en: Battle of Xiling: Wu commander Lu Kang repels Jin forces under Yang Hu and retakes Xiling

properties.headline: 晋军六路伐吴，王濬楼船下益州
properties.headline_en: Western Jin launches six-pronged invasion of Eastern Wu

properties.headline: 晋水陆大军直捣建业石头城，吴主孙皓面缚出降，西晋灭吴，三国归晋
properties.headline_en: Jin armies storm Jianye and receive Sun Hao’s surrender, conquering Wu and reunifying China

properties.headline: 西晋灭吴，三国归晋；颁占田制与罢州郡兵，开启“太康之治”
properties.headline_en: Western Jin conquers Wu to reunify China, enacts land laws, and disarms local commanderies

properties.headline: 太康末门阀骄奢斗富；武帝大封诸王出镇重兵，命刘渊领并州匈奴部
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu enfeoffs princes with regional armies and appoints Liu Yuan over Bingzhou Xiongnu

properties.headline: 晋武帝崩后惠帝即位，贾南风诛杨骏与辅政宗王，八王之乱爆发
properties.headline_en: After Emperor Wu dies, Empress Jia Nanfeng purges regents, sparking the War of the Eight Princes

properties.headline: 关陇氐羌齐万年之乱引发大饥；江统著《徙戎论》警诫五胡内迁隐患
properties.headline_en: Qi Wannian's uprising triggers Guanzhong famine; Jiang Tong warns of frontier settlement perils

properties.headline: 略阳氐帅李特率关陇六郡流民就食巴蜀，于绵竹起兵反晋
properties.headline_en: Di leader Li Te leads Guanzhong refugees south into Shu and rises against Jin at Mianzhu

properties.headline: 司马伦篡位引发诸王混战；司马颖据邺城、司马颙据长安联兵攻洛阳
properties.headline_en: After Sima Lun's usurpation, Princes Sima Ying at Ye and Sima Yong at Chang'an march on Luoyang

properties.headline: 司马颖遣并州匈奴五部刘渊归离石发兵，刘渊称汉王、李雄称成都王
properties.headline_en: Released to Bingzhou by Sima Ying, Liu Yuan proclaims Han Zhao as Li Xiong claims Chengdu

properties.headline: 李雄称帝建立成汉；司马越立晋怀帝，八王之乱终结
properties.headline_en: Li Xiong proclaims Cheng Han emperor as Prince Yue prevails

properties.headline: 司马睿用王导谋镇建邺，江东初定，王与马共天下之基立
properties.headline_en: Sima Rui and Wang Dao assume command of Jianye to stabilize Jiangdong

properties.headline: 永嘉之乱：汉赵刘曜攻陷洛阳，俘晋怀帝
properties.headline_en: Disaster of Yongjia: Han Zhao captures Luoyang and Emperor Huai

properties.headline: 晋愍帝在长安即位；祖逖中流击楫渡江北伐
properties.headline_en: Emperor Min enthroned in Chang'an; Zu Ti launches northern expedition

properties.headline: 刘曜围长安迫降晋愍帝，西晋亡；张氏据凉州、拓跋据代北、慕容据辽东
properties.headline_en: Liu Yao captures Chang’an and Emperor Min, ending Western Jin as northern states fragment

properties.headline: 司马睿在建康即晋王位建东晋；河西前凉、代北代国、辽东前燕并立
properties.headline_en: Sima Rui founds Eastern Jin at Jiankang alongside Former Liang, Dai & Murong Yan

properties.headline: 刘曜于长安改汉为前赵，石勒在襄国称赵王建后赵，汉赵分裂
properties.headline_en: Liu Yao renames Han to Former Zhao at Chang'an; Shi Le founds Later Zhao at Xiangguo

properties.headline: 王敦之乱：王敦自武昌举兵攻入建康，控制东晋朝政
properties.headline_en: Rebellion of Wang Dun: Wang Dun marches from Wuchang into Jiankang and controls the court

properties.headline: 前凉张骏擒戊己校尉赵贞，以其地置高昌郡
properties.headline_en: Zhang Jun of Former Liang ousts Wuji Colonel Zhao Zhen and founds Gaochang Commandery

properties.headline: 苏峻之乱：历阳内史苏峻反，攻陷建康台城，温峤、陶侃起兵讨平
properties.headline_en: Su Jun Rebellion: rebel forces seize Jiankang palace before defeat

properties.headline: 石勒于洛阳生擒前赵主刘曜，次年克长安灭前赵，后赵统一北方大部
properties.headline_en: Shi Le captures Former Zhao ruler Liu Yao at Luoyang and takes Chang’an, unifying the north

properties.headline: 石虎迁后赵都城至邺；慕容皝于辽东棘城称燕王，正式建立前燕
properties.headline_en: Shi Hu moves Later Zhao capital to Ye; Murong Huang proclaims Former Yan at Jicheng

properties.headline: 桓温西征灭成汉，收复巴蜀
properties.headline_en: Huan Wen conquers Cheng-Han and recovers Sichuan

properties.headline: 后赵石虎崩后诸子争位自残，大将军冉闵尽诛石氏建冉魏，颁杀胡令
properties.headline_en: Amid bloody strife after Shi Hu’s death, Ran Min exterminates the Shi clan and founds Ran Wei

properties.headline: 略阳氐帅苻洪子苻健率部自枋头西入潼关克长安，称天王建立前秦
properties.headline_en: Di leader Fu Jian marches west through Tong Pass to take Chang’an and founds Former Qin

properties.headline: 前燕慕容儁大败冉闵灭冉魏，迁都邺城正式称帝
properties.headline_en: Former Yan destroys Ran Wei; Murong Jun proclaims emperor at Ye

properties.headline: 王羲之与谢安等雅集会稽山阴兰亭，作《兰亭集序》
properties.headline_en: Wang Xizhi and Xie An gather at the Orchid Pavilion in Kuaiji, composing Preface to Lanting

properties.headline: 桓温首次北伐至灞上，王猛扪虱谈天下
properties.headline_en: Huan Wen’s first northern expedition reaches Bashang; Wang Meng meets Huan

properties.headline: 桓温第二次北伐大破姚襄，收复故都洛阳，修复先帝陵墓
properties.headline_en: Huan Wen's second northern expedition recovers Luoyang and repairs imperial tombs

properties.headline: 桓温主持推行“庚戌土断”，整顿侨置州郡户籍以充实东晋赋役
properties.headline_en: Huan Wen enforces the Gengxu Residence Registration to tax northern émigré households

properties.headline: 枋头之战：桓温北伐受挫，慕容垂大破晋军；垂遭忌投前秦
properties.headline_en: Battle of Fangtou: Murong Chui defeats Huan Wen before fleeing to Qin

properties.headline: 王猛于潞川大破前燕三十万主力，乘胜攻克邺城俘慕容暐，前燕亡
properties.headline_en: Wang Meng routs 300,000 Former Yan troops at Luchuan and captures Ye, destroying Former Yan

properties.headline: 前秦取东晋巴蜀，又灭前凉、代国，苻坚统一北方
properties.headline_en: Former Qin takes Ba-Shu from Jin and conquers Former Liang & Dai to unify North

properties.headline: 淝水之战：谢安、谢玄率八万北府兵大破苻坚大军，前秦瓦解
properties.headline_en: Battle of Fei River: Xie An & Xie Xuan’s Beifu army routs Fu Jian; Former Qin collapses

properties.headline: 慕容垂建后燕、姚苌建后秦，东晋收复巴蜀荆襄
properties.headline_en: Murong Chui founds Later Yan & Yao Chang founds Later Qin; Jin retakes Ba-Shu

properties.headline: 乞伏国仁在陇西建西秦；吕光据凉州建后凉
properties.headline_en: Qifu Guoren founds Western Qin; Lü Guang founds Later Liang

properties.headline: 代王什翼犍之孙拓跋珪于牛川重聚旧部即代王位，旋改国号魏（北魏）
properties.headline_en: Tuoba Gui rallies his clan at Niuchuan to restore the Kingdom of Dai and renames it Northern Wei

properties.headline: 参合陂之战，北魏大破后燕主力，进据中原
properties.headline_en: Battle of Canhe Slope: Northern Wei crushes the Later Yan army

properties.headline: 河西秃发乌孤据乐都建南凉，段业、沮渠蒙逊据张掖建北凉
properties.headline_en: Tufa Wugu founds Southern Liang at Ledu; Duan Ye & Juqu Mengxun found Northern Liang

properties.headline: 拓跋珪自盛乐迁都平城，正式称帝（北魏道武帝）
properties.headline_en: Tuoba Gui moves Northern Wei capital to Pingcheng and takes imperial title

properties.headline: 慕容德建南燕都广固；孙恩五斗米道起事席卷江东八郡，动摇门阀政治
properties.headline_en: Murong De founds Southern Yan; Sun En uprising shakes Jiangdong

properties.headline: 桓玄篡晋建楚，刘裕京口起兵复晋；谯纵建谯蜀，403年后凉降于后秦
properties.headline_en: Liu Yu rises at Jingkou against usurper Huan Xuan; Qiao Shu rises as Later Liang yields to Qin
properties.site: 京口 · 建康 · 成都

properties.headline: 赫连勃勃于朔方建胡夏；冯跋兄弟于龙城弑后燕慕容熙，拥高云建北燕
properties.headline_en: Helian Bobo founds Hu Xia; Feng Ba overthrows Later Yan ruler Murong Xi to found Northern Yan

properties.headline: 刘裕北伐攻破广固，灭南燕
properties.headline_en: Liu Yu’s northern expedition captures Guanggu and destroys Southern Yan

properties.headline: 刘裕遣朱龄石西征平定谯蜀，收复巴蜀
properties.headline_en: Liu Yu dispatches Zhu Lingshi to conquer Qiao Shu and recover Ba-Shu

properties.headline: 西秦乞伏炽磐袭破乐都灭南凉；北凉沮渠蒙逊迁都姑臧称河西王
properties.headline_en: Western Qin captures Ledu to destroy Southern Liang; Northern Liang moves its capital to Guzang

properties.headline: 刘裕北伐灭后秦，收复洛阳、长安
properties.headline_en: Liu Yu's northern expedition destroys Later Qin and retakes Luoyang & Chang'an

properties.headline: 晋恭帝禅位于刘裕，东晋亡，宋齐梁陈南朝开启
properties.headline_en: Emperor Gong abdicates to Liu Yu, ending Eastern Jin and opening Liu Song

properties.headline: 刘裕代晋建宋，南朝开始
properties.headline_en: Liu Yu replaces Jin with Liu Song, beginning the Southern Dynasties

properties.headline: 北魏取河南关中，太武帝又袭克胡夏都城统万城
properties.headline_en: Northern Wei takes Henan & Guanzhong and captures Hu Xia's capital Tongwancheng

properties.headline: 赫连定灭西秦后被俘，北魏灭胡夏；宋文帝元嘉之治
properties.headline_en: Helian Ding captured, Northern Wei conquers Xia; Era of Yuanjia in Liu Song

properties.headline: 北魏攻入龙城，北燕亡
properties.headline_en: Northern Wei marches into Longcheng, ending Northern Yan

properties.headline: 北魏太武帝灭北凉，统一北方，结束十六国
properties.headline_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei conquers Northern Liang, unifying northern China

properties.headline: 北魏太武帝采崔浩议下诏灭佛，焚毁寺塔经像，后文成帝复佛
properties.headline_en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei orders the suppression of Buddhism at Cui Hao’s urging

properties.headline: 宋文帝元嘉北伐失利，北魏太武帝南征饮马长江
properties.headline_en: Failed Yuanjia northern expedition; Northern Wei counterattacks to the Yangtze at Guabu

properties.headline: 北魏慕容白曜尽取刘宋淮北四州，南北分界南移淮水
properties.headline_en: Northern Wei annexes Liu Song’s four provinces north of the Huai, shifting the border to Huai

properties.headline: 刘宋桂阳王自寻阳举兵逼建康，萧道成守新亭平叛执掌禁军与朝政
properties.headline_en: Prince of Guiyang rebels from Xunyang; Xiao Daocheng defends Xinting and seizes Liu Song power

properties.headline: 权臣萧道成继废杀宋后废帝后，迫宋顺帝禅位建南齐，南朝宋亡
properties.headline_en: Having deposed Emperor Houfei, Xiao Daocheng forces Emperor Shun to abdicate and founds Qi

properties.headline: 北魏冯太后与孝文帝颁行均田制与三长制，奠定田制根基
properties.headline_en: Empress Dowager Feng and Emperor Xiaowen enact the Equal-Field and Three-Elders systems

properties.headline: 北魏孝文帝迁都洛阳，推行汉化改革
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei moves the capital to Luoyang and promotes sinicization

properties.headline: 齐明帝与东昏侯大诛高武子孙及朝臣，雍州刺史萧衍于襄阳起兵
properties.headline_en: After bloody court purges under Marquis Donghun, governor Xiao Yan rises in Xiangyang

properties.headline: 萧衍率军顺江东下攻克建康，迫齐和帝禅位建梁，开启天监之治
properties.headline_en: Xiao Yan marches down the Yangtze to take Jiankang, deposing Southern Qi to found Liang

properties.headline: 钟离之战：梁将韦睿、曹景宗火攻水淹大破北魏三十万大军
properties.headline_en: Battle of Zhongli: Liang generals Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong rout 300,000 Northern Wei troops

properties.headline: 六镇之乱：破六韩拔陵于沃野镇起兵，北魏边防崩解
properties.headline_en: Rebellion of the Six Garrisons: Poliuhan Baling’s frontier uprising shatters Northern Wei

properties.headline: 河阴之变：尔朱荣奉孝庄帝元子攸入洛，沉胡太后并屠北魏王公两千余人
properties.headline_en: Heyin Massacre: Erzhu Rong installs Yuan Ziyou, drowns Empress Hu, and slays 2,000 court nobles

properties.headline: 梁将陈庆之率七千白袍军北伐连克三十二城，攻入洛阳
properties.headline_en: Liang general Chen Qingzhi leads 7,000 White-Robe troops north, taking 32 cities and Luoyang

properties.headline: 孝庄帝不甘受制，于洛阳明光殿设伏手刃权臣尔朱荣；尔朱兆反扑陷洛阳
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xiaozhuang ambushes and slays warlord Erzhu Rong in Luoyang; Erzhu Zhao storms the city

properties.headline: 韩陵之战：高欢以少胜多大破尔朱氏二十万联军，入洛阳执掌北魏朝政
properties.headline_en: Battle of Hanling: Gao Huan routs the 200,000-strong Erzhu coalition and seizes court power

properties.headline: 魏孝武帝西奔长安依宇文泰，高欢立孝静帝迁都邺城，北魏分裂为东西魏
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xiaowu flees to Yuwen Tai in Chang'an while Gao Huan installs Eastern Wei at Ye

properties.headline: 沙苑之战：宇文泰以少胜多破高欢，创西魏府兵制
properties.headline_en: Battle of Shayuan: Yuwen Tai routs Gao Huan’s Eastern Wei army and founds the Fubing system

properties.headline: 玉壁之战：西魏韦孝宽坚守五十日，挫败东魏高欢大军
properties.headline_en: Siege of Yubi: Western Wei general Wei Xiaokuan holds for 50 days, repelling Gao Huan

properties.headline: 侯景之乱攻陷建康台城，梁武帝萧衍饿死，江南残破
properties.headline_en: Hou Jing's Rebellion storms Jiankang Palace; aged Emperor Wu starves as Jiangnan is ravaged

properties.headline: 高洋迫东魏禅让建北齐；西魏宇文泰设八柱国十二大将军，关陇集团成型
properties.headline_en: Gao Yang founds Northern Qi at Ye; Yuwen Tai institutes the Eight Pillars system in Western Wei

properties.headline: 王僧辩、陈霸先东讨平侯景，次年萧绎于江陵即位
properties.headline_en: Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian crush Hou Jing; Emperor Yuan ascends at Jiangling

properties.headline: 突厥土门可汗大破柔然，建突厥汗国，称雄漠北
properties.headline_en: Bumin Qaghan crushes the Rouran north of Huaihuang and founds the First Turkic Khaganate

properties.headline: 西魏尉迟迥伐蜀攻克成都，尽取萧梁巴蜀益州之地
properties.headline_en: Western Wei general Yuchi Jiong conquers Chengdu and annexes Sichuan from the Liang dynasty

properties.headline: 西魏于谨攻陷江陵，梁元帝焚书十四万卷；西魏立萧詧为西梁主
properties.headline_en: Western Wei takes Jiangling as Emperor Yuan burns 140,000 scrolls; Western Liang is installed

properties.headline: 陈霸先诛王僧辩掌梁政，受禅建陈；宇文泰子宇文觉代西魏建北周
properties.headline_en: After slaying Wang Sengbian, Chen Baxian founds Chen; Yuwen Tai's son Yuwen Jue founds Zhou

properties.headline: 太建北伐：陈将吴明彻大破北齐，尽复江北淮南之地
properties.headline_en: Taijian Northern Expedition: Chen general Wu Mingche defeats Northern Qi and recovers Huainan

properties.headline: 北周武帝下诏禁佛道二教、沙汰僧尼归农充兵，蓄力统一北方
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou proscribes Buddhism and Daoism, returning monks to farms and armies

properties.headline: 北周武帝灭北齐，北方再统一
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou conquers Northern Qi, reunifying the north

properties.headline: 吕梁之战北周破陈军生擒吴明彻，次年韦孝宽南征尽夺淮南，陈退守长江
properties.headline_en: Northern Zhou captures Wu Mingche at Luliang and seizes all of Huainan north of the Yangtze

properties.headline: 杨坚以丞相辅政，韦孝宽平尉迟迥，焚毁邺城
properties.headline_en: Regent Yang Jian has Wei Xiaokuan crush Yuchi Jiong and razes the old capital of Ye

properties.headline: 杨坚建隋，定都大兴；确立三省六部制，颁《开皇律》
properties.headline_en: Yang Jian founds Sui at Daxing; Three Departments, Six Ministries and the Kaihuang Code

properties.headline: 隋文帝废西梁国，江陵并入隋境，大造战船备战伐陈
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wen of Sui abolishes Western Liang at Jiangling and prepares to conquer Chen

properties.headline: 晋王杨广统军渡江，韩擒虎、贺若弼攻克建康擒陈后主，隋灭陈统一全国
properties.headline_en: Commanded by Yang Guang, Sui armies cross the Yangtze and capture Jiankang, reunifying China

properties.headline: 东突厥启民可汗内附，隋于河套北筑大利城
properties.headline_en: Eastern Tujue Qimin Qaghan submits to Sui

properties.headline: 隋炀帝营建东都洛阳、开通济渠；始设进士科创立科举制
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yang builds Luoyang, digs the Tongji Canal, and founds the Jinshi civil exam

properties.headline: 隋炀帝开凿永济渠，北通涿郡，南达黄河
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yang constructs the Yongji Canal north to Zhuo Commandery

properties.headline: 隋炀帝西巡张掖，破吐谷浑置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yang defeats Tuyuhun and establishes Xihai and three other western commanderies

properties.headline: 隋炀帝开凿江南河，大运河贯通南北
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yang completes the Grand Canal linking Jiangnan and the north

properties.headline: 隋炀帝征调百万大军东征高句丽，萨水失利
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yang launches his first grand campaign against Goguryeo

properties.headline: 隋炀帝雁门被突厥围困；次年瓦岗军克洛口仓群雄并起
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yang besieged at Yanmen by Turks; Wagang rebels seize Luokou Granary as revolts spread

properties.headline: 李渊太原起兵，攻入大兴城；瓦岗军据中原
properties.headline_en: Li Yuan rises in Taiyuan and captures Daxing (Chang'an)

properties.headline: 宇文化及江都兵变弑隋炀帝，隋亡
properties.headline_en: Yuwen Huaji mutinies at Jiangdu and kills Emperor Yang, ending the Sui

properties.headline: 隋炀帝江都遇弑后，唐王李渊迫隋恭帝杨侑禅让，于长安称帝建立唐朝
properties.headline_en: After Emperor Yang is slain at Jiangdu, Li Yuan receives the Sui abdication and founds Tang

properties.headline: 虎牢之战李世民擒窦建德、降王世充；李靖平萧铣
properties.headline_en: Battle of Hulao: Li Shimin captures Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong; Li Jing pacifies Xiao Xian

properties.headline: 唐高祖颁行《武德令》，确立均田制、租庸调制与府兵制根基
properties.headline_en: Emperor Gaozu promulgates the Wude Statutes establishing equal-field and tripartite tax systems

properties.headline: 玄武门之变：秦王李世民伏兵诛太子建成、齐王元吉，唐高祖退位禅让
properties.headline_en: Xuanwu Gate Incident: Prince Li Shimin ambushes Crown Prince Jiancheng and ascends as Taizong

properties.headline: 唐太宗改元贞观，任房玄龄、杜如晦定官制，虚怀纳谏开创“贞观之治”
properties.headline_en: Emperor Taizong inaugurates the Reign of Zhenguan with Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui

properties.headline: 李靖灭东突厥，西北诸君尊唐太宗为“天可汗”，置定襄、云中都督府
properties.headline_en: Li Jing conquers Eastern Tujue; steppe rulers hail Emperor Taizong as Heavenly Qaghan

properties.headline: 李靖分道远征吐谷浑抵黄河源柏海，伏允可汗降唐
properties.headline_en: Li Jing leads a six-column expedition to Lake Baihai, forcing Tuyuhun King Buyun to submit

properties.headline: 侯君集灭高昌，唐置安西都护府
properties.headline_en: Hou Junji conquers Gaochang; Tang establishes the Anxi Protectorate

properties.headline: 文成公主入藏，与吐蕃松赞干布联姻
properties.headline_en: Princess Wencheng enters Tibet to marry Songtsen Gampo

properties.headline: 玄奘自天竺载经归长安译经；唐太宗亲征高句丽克辽东城
properties.headline_en: Xuanzang returns to Chang'an with Sanskrit sutras; Emperor Taizong campaigns in Goguryeo

properties.headline: 王玄策借吐蕃兵大破中天竺阿罗那顺，声威达南亚
properties.headline_en: Wang Xuance leads Tibetan-Nepalese forces to defeat Arunāśva in Central India

properties.headline: 长孙无忌等撰成《永徽律疏》（唐律疏议）颁行天下，集礼法大成
properties.headline_en: Zhangsun Wuji completes the Tang Code with Commentary, the pinnacle of classical Chinese law

properties.headline: 苏定方灭西突厥，置昆陵、濛池都护府，唐疆西极咸海
properties.headline_en: Su Dingfang defeats Western Tujue; Kunling & Mengchi Protectorates reach the Aral Sea

properties.headline: 白江口海战大破日济水军；同年吐蕃禄东赞攻灭吐谷浑，诺曷钵奔凉州
properties.headline_en: Battle of Baekgang crushes Yamato-Baekje fleet; Tubo annexes Tuyuhun & takes Qinghai

properties.headline: 李勣攻克平壤灭高句丽，置安东都护府
properties.headline_en: Li Ji captures Pyongyang, conquering Goguryeo; Andong Protectorate set up

properties.headline: 大非川之战：薛仁贵败于吐蕃，吐谷浑入吐蕃；吐蕃陷安西四镇
properties.headline_en: Battle of Dafeichuan: Tang defeated; Tibet annexes Tuyuhun and takes the Four Garrisons of Anxi

properties.headline: 安东都护府自平壤内迁辽东故城
properties.headline_en: Andong Protectorate relocated from Pyongyang to Liaodong

properties.headline: 裴行俭擒阿史那都支，复置安西四镇；改交州都督府为安南都护府
properties.headline_en: Pei Xingjian restores the Four Garrisons of Anxi; Jiaozhou becomes the Annam Protectorate
properties.site: 碎叶 · 安南都护府（交州）

properties.headline: 武则天于洛阳废中宗临朝称制，遣军讨平徐敬业扬州起兵
properties.headline_en: Empress Dowager Wu Zetian deposes Zhongzong at Luoyang and crushes Xu Jingye's Yangzhou revolt

properties.headline: 垂拱二年武则天弃安西四镇，四镇复陷吐蕃
properties.headline_en: Wu Zetian withdraws from the Four Garrisons of Anxi, which fall to Tibet again

properties.headline: 武则天改唐为周，定都神都洛阳
properties.headline_en: Wu Zetian proclaims the Zhou dynasty at Shendu Luoyang

properties.headline: 王孝杰大破吐蕃收复安西四镇，复置安西都护府于龟兹
properties.headline_en: Wang Xiaojie routs Tibet, recovers the Four Garrisons and restores the Anxi seat at Kucha

properties.headline: 粟末靺鞨大祚荣于东牟山立震国，后受唐封渤海郡王建渤海国
properties.headline_en: Dae Jo-yeong founds the state of Balhae (Bohai) at Mount Dongmou in Jilin

properties.headline: 武则天于庭州设北庭都护府，统辖天山北路
properties.headline_en: Wu Zetian establishes Beiting Protectorate north of the Tianshan

properties.headline: 神龙政变：张柬之等拥唐中宗于洛阳复辟，复唐国号
properties.headline_en: Shenlong Coup: Chancellor Zhang Jianzhi restores Emperor Zhongzong in Luoyang, reviving Tang

properties.headline: 景龙政变：太子李重俊发羽林兵诛武三思，兵败被杀
properties.headline_en: Jinglong Coup: Crown Prince Li Chongjun slays Wu Sansi with palace guards but falls in battle

properties.headline: 唐隆政变：李隆基联结太平公主诛韦后，奉唐睿宗复位
properties.headline_en: Tanglong Coup: Li Longji and Princess Taiping eliminate Empress Wei and restore Ruizong

properties.headline: 先天政变：唐玄宗诛太平公主党开启开元盛世；封渤海郡王
properties.headline_en: Xiantian Coup: Xuanzong ousts Princess Taiping to open the Kaiyuan era and invests Bohai

properties.headline: 王君㚟、信安王李祎反击吐蕃拔石堡城，固河西防线
properties.headline_en: Tang generals Wang Junchuo and Li Yi capture Shibao Fortress from Tibet, securing Hexi

properties.headline: 唐玄宗分全国为开元十五道，置采访使定型道州监察制
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xuanzong divides the empire into Fifteen Kaiyuan Circuits under commissioners

properties.headline: 唐册封皮逻阁为云南王，六诏合一建南诏迁都太和城
properties.headline_en: Tang invests Piluoge as King of Yunnan; the Six Zhao unite to form the Nanzhao Kingdom

properties.headline: 唐廷改元天宝，沿边常设安西、范阳等十节度使，外重内轻
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xuanzong inaugurates the Tianbao era and establishes the Ten Frontier Military Commands

properties.headline: 骨力裴罗灭后突厥建回鹘汗国，受唐封为怀仁可汗
properties.headline_en: Kutlug Bilge Kül founds the Uyghur Khaganate, invested by Tang as Huairen Qaghan
properties.site: 回鹘牙帐（哈拉巴尔嘎斯）

properties.headline: 高仙芝率军翻越帕米尔远征小勃律，西域震恐归附
properties.headline_en: General Gao Xianzhi leads 10,000 troops across the Pamirs to conquer Gilgit (Little Balur)
properties.site: 连云堡 · 小勃律（吉尔吉特）

properties.headline: 怛罗斯之战，造纸术西传阿拉伯世界
properties.headline_en: Battle of Talas; papermaking spreads to the Islamic world

properties.headline: 鉴真第六次东渡自扬州启航，次年抵日本传播律宗与唐文化
properties.headline_en: Jianzhen sails from Yangzhou on his sixth voyage, bringing Vinaya and Tang culture to Japan

properties.headline: 安禄山、史思明于范阳起兵，安史之乱爆发
properties.headline_en: An Lushan and Shi Siming rebel at Fanyang, sparking the An–Shi Rebellion

properties.headline: 马嵬驿兵变诛杨国忠、赐死杨贵妃；唐肃宗灵武即位
properties.headline_en: Mawei Mutiny: guards execute Yang Guozhong and Consort Yang; Suzong ascends at Lingwu

properties.headline: 郭子仪借回纥兵收复长安、洛阳两京，安庆绪退保邺城
properties.headline_en: Guo Ziyi recovers Chang'an and Luoyang with Uyghur cavalry; An Qingxu falls back to Yecheng

properties.headline: 安史之乱平定，河朔三镇割据肇端；吐蕃一度攻入长安
properties.headline_en: An–Shi Rebellion ends; Hebei warlords keep their garrisons; Tibet briefly seizes Chang'an

properties.headline: 凉州陷于吐蕃，河西走廊被截断，安西北庭孤悬坚守
properties.headline_en: Liangzhou falls to Tibet, severing Hexi; Anxi & Beiting hold out as exclaves

properties.headline: 杨炎推行两税法，赋税制度重大转型
properties.headline_en: Yang Yan enacts the Two-Tax System fiscal reform

properties.headline: 泾原兵变与奉天之难，唐德宗颁《罪己诏》姑息河朔藩镇
properties.headline_en: Jingyuan Mutiny besieges Emperor Dezong at Fengtian; Penitential Edict appeases garrisons

properties.headline: 沙州陷于吐蕃，唐朝陇右、河西州县尽失
properties.headline_en: Shazhou falls to the Tibetan Empire as Tang loses Longyou and Hexi

properties.headline: 吐蕃联结葛逻禄攻陷北庭都护府，安西四镇孤悬绝域，唐廷与西域隔绝
properties.headline_en: Tibetan and Karluk forces capture Beiting, cutting the Tang court off from the Western Regions

properties.headline: 永贞内禅：王叔文、柳宗元革新受挫，俱文珍迫顺宗禅位
properties.headline_en: Yongzhen Abdication: eunuch Ju Wenzhen halts the Wang Shuwen reform and forces Shunzong out

properties.headline: 李愬雪夜入蔡州平淮西，史称元和中兴
properties.headline_en: Li Su takes Caizhou in a snowy night raid; Yuanhe Restoration

properties.headline: 长庆科举覆试案引发“牛李党争”，朝臣朋党相倾长达四十余年
properties.headline_en: The Changqing examination scandal ignites forty years of Niu-Li factional strife at court

properties.headline: 唐蕃长庆会盟：继长安盟誓后再盟于逻些，次年立会盟碑于大昭寺
properties.headline_en: Changqing Treaty sworn again at Lhasa after Chang'an; treaty pillar raised at Jokhang in 823

properties.headline: 甘露之变：唐文宗与李训谋诛仇士良事败，晚唐宦官专权
properties.headline_en: Sweet Dew Incident: Emperor Wenzong and Li Xun’s failed plot against Qiu Shiliang ends in purge

properties.headline: 回鹘汗国崩溃；唐武宗与李德裕破回鹘、平泽潞（会昌中兴）
properties.headline_en: Uyghur Khaganate collapses; Emperor Wuzong and Li Deyu defeat Uyghurs and Zelu (Huichang Era)

properties.headline: 唐武宗下诏拆毁天下佛寺四千六百余所、僧尼还俗，史称会昌法难
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wuzong orders the Huichang suppression of Buddhism, secularizing 260,000 monastics

properties.headline: 张议潮沙州起义，建归义军收复瓜沙甘肃等十一州归唐
properties.headline_en: Zhang Yichao's Guiyi Circuit recovers Dunhuang, Guazhou and eleven Hexi prefectures

properties.headline: 赴援安南之桂林戍卒由庞勋率领起义北攻徐州，截断江淮漕运
properties.headline_en: Pang Xun leads the Guilin garrison mutiny north to seize Xuzhou and sever the Grand Canal

properties.headline: 王仙芝、黄巢于曹州发动唐末大起义
properties.headline_en: Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao launch the late-Tang peasant uprising

properties.headline: 黄巢破潼关入长安称帝建齐；唐僖宗奔蜀，唐室衰亡
properties.headline_en: Huang Chao captures Chang’an and proclaims the Qi dynasty; Emperor Xizong flees to Shu

properties.headline: 唐僖宗还京，朱温、李克用等藩镇并立，唐室政令不出畿辅
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xizong returns to Chang'an as warlords Zhu Wen and Li Keyong carve out rival domains

properties.headline: 李克用入关中讨李茂贞，王建据蜀、杨行密据淮南，藩镇割据成型
properties.headline_en: Li Keyong marches into Guanzhong as Wang Jian and Yang Xingmi carve out warlord regimes

properties.headline: 朱温劫唐昭宗毁长安东迁洛阳，旋弑昭宗立哀帝（次年白马之祸）
properties.headline_en: Zhu Wen forces Emperor Zhaozong from ruined Chang'an to Luoyang, then assassinates him

properties.headline: 朱温逼唐哀帝禅位建后梁，唐朝灭亡
properties.headline_en: Zhu Wen deposes Emperor Ai to found Later Liang, ending the Tang dynasty

properties.headline: 朱温代唐建后梁；王建在成都称帝建前蜀，契丹耶律阿保机称汗
properties.headline_en: Zhu Wen replaces Tang with Later Liang; Wang Jian founds Former Shu and Abaoji leads Khitan

properties.headline: 后梁册封王审知为闽王，定都福州保境安民
properties.headline_en: Later Liang invests Wang Shenzhi as King of Min at Fuzhou

properties.headline: 吴越王钱镠筑钱塘捍海石塘；徐温掌淮南政固杨吴基业
properties.headline_en: Qian Liu builds Qiantang sea walls in Wuyue; Xu Wen consolidates Yang Wu in Jianghuai

properties.headline: 刘守光在幽州称大燕皇帝，晋王李存勖兴兵讨燕（913年灭桀燕）
properties.headline_en: Liu Shouguang proclaims Great Yan in Youzhou; Li Cunxu campaigns against Yan (falls in 913)

properties.headline: 耶律阿保机建契丹国，称帝建元神册
properties.headline_en: Yelü Abaoji proclaims the Khitan Empire

properties.headline: 刘龑在番禺称帝建南汉，定都兴王府
properties.headline_en: Liu Yan proclaims Southern Han at Xingwangfu (Guangzhou)

properties.headline: 李存勖于魏州称帝建后唐，旋遣奇兵自郓州渡河袭破汴州，后梁末帝自尽
properties.headline_en: Proclaiming Later Tang at Weizhou, Li Cunxu launches a surprise crossing to take Bianzhou

properties.headline: 后唐庄宗遣军灭前蜀并有巴蜀；次年契丹灭渤海国
properties.headline_en: Later Tang conquers Former Shu (Sichuan); Khitan conquers Balhae in 926

properties.headline: 兴教门之变：郭从谦洛阳兵变弑后唐庄宗，李嗣源即位
properties.headline_en: Xingjiao Gate Incident: Zhuangzong Li Cunxu dies in a Luoyang mutiny; Li Siyuan ascends

properties.headline: 后唐册封马殷为楚国王，与荆南高氏分扼湖湘荆襄商道
properties.headline_en: Later Tang invests Ma Yin as King of Chu alongside Jingnan astride middle Yangtze trade

properties.headline: 后唐西川节度使孟知祥兼并东川据有全蜀，趁唐乱于成都称帝建后蜀
properties.headline_en: After annexing Dongchuan to control Sichuan, governor Meng Zhixiang proclaims Later Shu

properties.headline: 河东节度使石敬瑭反后唐，认契丹主为父帝割燕云十六州，灭唐建后晋
properties.headline_en: Rebelling at Taiyuan, Shi Jingtang cedes the Sixteen Prefectures to Khitan and founds Later Jin

properties.headline: 徐知诰（李昪）代杨吴建南唐，定都金陵
properties.headline_en: Xu Zhigao (Li Bian) replaces Wu to found Southern Tang at Jinling

properties.headline: 吴权于白藤江设桩大破南汉水军，于交州称王自立，安南脱离中原王朝
properties.headline_en: Ngo Quyen defeats the Southern Han fleet on the Bach Dang River and rules Jiaozhou independently

properties.headline: 后晋高祖石敬瑭卒，出帝石重贵即位，用景延广议对契丹“称孙不称臣”
properties.headline_en: After Shi Jingtang dies, successor Shi Chonggui refuses to submit as a vassal to the Khitan

properties.headline: 南唐攻灭闽国，与吴越分其地
properties.headline_en: Southern Tang conquers Min and partitions its territory with Wuyue

properties.headline: 契丹南下俘石重贵灭后晋，改国号辽；河东节度使刘知远于太原建后汉
properties.headline_en: Khitan captures Shi Chonggui to end Later Jin and proclaims Liao; Liu Zhiyuan founds Later Han

properties.headline: 枢密使郭威遭后汉隐帝猜忌起兵代汉建后周；刘崇建北汉，南唐灭马楚
properties.headline_en: Driven to mutiny by Later Han, Guo Wei founds Later Zhou; Northern Han rises and Ma Chu falls
properties.site: 汴州 · 太原 · 潭州

properties.headline: 高平之战：周世宗柴荣亲征，赵匡胤死战大破北汉与辽联军
properties.headline_en: Battle of Gaoping: Chai Rong and Zhao Kuangyin crush the combined Northern Han and Liao army

properties.headline: 周世宗西征后蜀收复秦、凤、成、阶四州，同年冬南征淮南
properties.headline_en: Shizong of Later Zhou recovers Qin, Feng, Cheng, and Jie from Later Shu and attacks Huainan

properties.headline: 周世宗三征南唐功成：李璟去帝号献江北淮南十四州
properties.headline_en: Shizong of Later Zhou compels Southern Tang to cede all 14 prefectures north of the Yangtze

properties.headline: 周世宗北伐辽国，收复瀛、莫、易三州与三关
properties.headline_en: Northern campaign of Zhou Shizong recovers Three Passes and Three Prefectures

properties.headline: 周世宗崩后幼主柴宗训嗣位，殿前都点检赵匡胤陈桥兵变，受禅建宋
properties.headline_en: After Chai Rong leaves a child heir, commander Zhao Kuangyin stages the Chenqiao Mutiny

properties.headline: 殿前都点检赵匡胤发动陈桥兵变，回师开封受后周恭帝禅位，建立北宋
properties.headline_en: Palace commander Zhao Kuangyin stages the Chenqiao Mutiny and receives the Later Zhou abdication

properties.headline: 宋太祖“杯酒释兵权”定重文轻武，继设通判、转运使收地方权
properties.headline_en: Emperor Taizu disarms generals over wine and appoints vice-prefects and fiscal commissioners

properties.headline: 慕容延钊假道灭虢，北宋平定荆南与湖南
properties.headline_en: Northern Song annexes the Jingnan and Chu (Hunan) regimes along the Yangtze

properties.headline: 王全斌攻入成都灭后蜀孟昶降，花蕊夫人赋诗叹亡国
properties.headline_en: Song general Wang Quanbin conquers Later Shu in Chengdu; Consort Huarui laments its surrender

properties.headline: 潘美率宋军克广州，刘鋹降，南汉亡
properties.headline_en: Pan Mei captures Guangzhou and accepts Liu Chang’s surrender, ending Southern Han

properties.headline: 曹彬率宋军攻克金陵，李煜降，南唐亡
properties.headline_en: Cao Bin captures Jinling and accepts Li Yu’s surrender, ending Southern Tang

properties.headline: 斧声烛影：宋太祖万岁殿夜饮暴崩，晋王赵光义即位
properties.headline_en: Candlelight and Axe-Sound Mystery: Emperor Taizu dies suddenly; brother Taizong ascends

properties.headline: 吴越王钱俶纳土归宋，江南和平统一
properties.headline_en: King Qian Chu of Wuyue peacefully surrenders territory to Song

properties.headline: 宋太宗灭北汉结束十国分裂；高梁河之战北伐失利
properties.headline_en: Emperor Taizong conquers Northern Han, ending Ten Kingdoms; routed by Liao at Gaoliang River

properties.headline: 雍熙北伐失利，杨业于陈家谷力战殉国
properties.headline_en: Yongxi Northern Expedition fails; Yang Ye falls at Chenjiagu

properties.headline: 宋太宗分全国为至道十五路，定型“路—州—县”体制
properties.headline_en: Emperor Taizong divides the realm into Fifteen Circuits, establishing Song circuit rule

properties.headline: 李继迁攻陷北宋灵州改西平府，党项尽据河套平原
properties.headline_en: Li Jiqian captures Song Lingzhou as Xiping Prefecture, securing the Hetao Plain

properties.headline: 辽萧太后与圣宗统军南下抵澶州，寇准力劝宋真宗亲征，订立澶渊之盟
properties.headline_en: Liao forces reach Chanzhou; Kou Zhun urges Zhenzong to the front, sealing the Chanyuan Treaty

properties.headline: 辽圣宗营建中京大定府；宋辽沿边广设榷场互市
properties.headline_en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao builds the Central Capital; Song and Liao open border trade markets

properties.headline: 宋真宗升宋州应天府为南京陪都
properties.headline_en: Emperor Zhenzong elevates Yingtianfu of Songzhou to Southern Capital of Song

properties.headline: 成都设益州交子务，发行世界最早官方纸币“交子”
properties.headline_en: Official Jiaozi Bureau established in Chengdu, issuing first paper money

properties.headline: 元昊于兴庆府称帝建大夏（西夏）
properties.headline_en: Li Yuanhao proclaims the Western Xia empire at Xingqingfu (Yinchuan)

properties.headline: 好水川之战：西夏元昊设伏歼灭任福主力，震动宋廷
properties.headline_en: Battle of Haoshuichuan: Western Xia ambushes Ren Fu's Song army, spurring court reforms

properties.headline: 宋辽达成“重熙增币”；宋仁宗建大名府为北京陪都以备御辽
properties.headline_en: Song and Liao conclude Chongxi silver-silk increase; Renzong makes Damingfu Northern Capital

properties.headline: 范仲淹、富弼主持推行“庆历新政”
properties.headline_en: Fan Zhongyan leads the Qingli Reforms

properties.headline: 宋夏订立“庆历和议”，元昊称臣、北宋岁赐银绢茶
properties.headline_en: Song and Western Xia sign the Qingli Peace Accord: Yuanhao submits in return for annual gifts

properties.headline: 黄河于澶州商胡埽决口北流，东汉以来王景故道废弃
properties.headline_en: Yellow River breaches at Shanghu in Chanzhou, shifting north and ending the Wang Jing course

properties.headline: 欧阳修主持嘉祐二年贡举，苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢同榜登科
properties.headline_en: Ouyang Xiu presides over the 1057 exam, graduating Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong, and Zhang Zai

properties.headline: 宋神宗任用王安石推行熙宁变法
properties.headline_en: Emperor Shenzong appoints Wang Anshi to enact the Xining New Policies

properties.headline: 王韶熙河开边，收复熙、河、洮、岷等六州，新置熙河路
properties.headline_en: Wang Shao's Xihe Campaign recovers Xi, He, Tao, and Min prefectures, establishing Xihe Circuit

properties.headline: 司马光历时十九年编成编年体通史巨著《资治通鉴》进呈宋神宗
properties.headline_en: Sima Guang completes the 294-scroll Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance after 19 years

properties.headline: 高太后垂帘起用司马光尽废新法（元祐更化），党争激化
properties.headline_en: Empress Dowager Gao appoints Sima Guang to repeal Wang Anshi’s reforms (Yuanyou Reversal)

properties.headline: 王厚、童贯发起“河湟开边”，收复青唐置西宁州
properties.headline_en: Hehuang Campaign: Wang Hou and Tong Guan recover Qingtang and establish Xining Prefecture

properties.headline: 宋徽宗任蔡京设应奉局与苏杭造作局，大兴“花石纲”劳民伤财
properties.headline_en: Emperor Huizong and Cai Jing launch the Flower-and-Rock Convoy, draining the southeast

properties.headline: 完颜阿骨打在会宁称帝建金，攻取辽东与上京
properties.headline_en: Wanyan Aguda proclaims the Jin dynasty at Huining and takes eastern Liao

properties.headline: 北宋遣马政、赵良嗣自登州泛海使金，订立“海上之盟”约夹攻辽朝
properties.headline_en: Song envoys sail from Dengzhou to conclude the Alliance on the Sea with Jin against Liao

properties.headline: 方腊江南起义攻陷杭州震动东南，童贯率北伐军南下讨平
properties.headline_en: Fang La's uprising seizes Hangzhou in the southeast before Tong Guan suppresses the rebels

properties.headline: 金依海上之盟交割燕京六州空城，北宋置燕山府路
properties.headline_en: Jin hands over six stripped Yanjing prefectures; Song establishes Yanshan Circuit

properties.headline: 完颜娄室俘辽天祚帝，金朝灭辽
properties.headline_en: Jurchen Jin general Wanyan Loushi captures Emperor Tianzuo, ending Liao

properties.headline: 靖康之变：金军二围东京攻陷汴梁，掳宋徽宗、钦宗二帝北去，北宋亡
properties.headline_en: Jingkang Incident: Jin armies storm Kaifeng and abduct Emperors Huizong and Qinzong, ending Song

properties.headline: 赵构即位于南京应天府，南宋开始
properties.headline_en: Zhao Gou (Emperor Gaozong) enthroned at Yingtianfu, beginning Southern Song

properties.headline: 苗刘兵变：苗傅、刘正彦于杭州逼高宗禅位，韩世忠平叛
properties.headline_en: Miao-Liu Mutiny: Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan depose Gaozong; Han Shizhong restores him

properties.headline: 韩世忠黄天荡阻击金兀术水军
properties.headline_en: Han Shizhong blocks Wuzhu's Jin fleet at Huangtiandang

properties.headline: 岳飞挥师北伐收复襄阳、随、郢、唐、邓、信阳六郡
properties.headline_en: Yue Fei recovers the six commanderies of Xiangyang, Suizhou, Yingzhou, Tangzhou, and Dengzhou

properties.headline: 宋高宗赵构结束巡幸，正式以临安府为行在，秦桧复相主持议和
properties.headline_en: Emperor Gaozong settles his temporary capital at Lin'an Prefecture as Qin Hui leads peace talks

properties.headline: 岳飞北伐，郾城、颍昌大捷，进兵朱仙镇
properties.headline_en: Yue Fei's northern campaign wins victories at Yancheng and Zhuxianzhen

properties.headline: 秦桧构陷冤杀岳武穆，宋金订立《绍兴和议》，划淮河—大散关为界
properties.headline_en: Qin Hui executes Yue Fei and concludes the Treaty of Shaoxing along the Huai and Dasan Pass

properties.headline: 金海陵王完颜亮自上京迁都燕京，改名中都大兴府
properties.headline_en: Jin ruler Wanyan Liang moves the imperial capital from Shangjing to Zhongdu (Beijing)

properties.headline: 金海陵王南侵，虞允文采石矶大捷
properties.headline_en: Yu Yunwen defeats Jin Emperor Wanyan Liang at the Battle of Caishi

properties.headline: 宋孝宗隆兴北伐，次年订立隆兴和议
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xiaozong's Longxing Northern Expedition and Peace Accord

properties.headline: 南宋乾淳之治与金大定之治对峙；朱熹陆九渊鹅湖之会
properties.headline_en: Qian-Chun and Dading eras bring stability; Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debate at Goose Lake

properties.headline: 绍熙内禅赵汝愚拥立宋宁宗；同年黄河阳武决口夺泗入淮
properties.headline_en: Shaoxi Abdication enthrones Ningzong; Yellow River breaches at Yangwu into the Huai
properties.site: 临安 · 阳武 · 淮安

properties.headline: 韩侂胄指斥朱熹理学为“伪学”并列庆元党籍五十余人，史称庆元党禁
properties.headline_en: Han Tuozhou proscribes Zhu Xi’s Neo-Confucianism as False Learning in the Qingyuan Partisan Ban

properties.headline: 铁木真相继攻灭克烈、乃蛮等部统一漠北草原，于斡难河源称成吉思汗
properties.headline_en: Having defeated the Kereit and Naiman to unite the steppe, Temüjin is proclaimed Genghis Khan

properties.headline: 韩侂胄“开禧北伐”失利被诛，次年宋金订立《嘉定和议》
properties.headline_en: Han Tuozhou's Kaixi Northern Expedition fails; Song and Jin conclude the Treaty of Jiading

properties.headline: 蒙古攻陷金中都，金迁都汴京，黄河以北与辽东被蒙古吞并
properties.headline_en: Mongols capture Jin capital Zhongdu; Jin moves south to Bianjing, losing half its territory

properties.headline: 成吉思汗六盘山病逝，蒙古灭西夏
properties.headline_en: Genghis Khan dies at Mount Liupan as Mongol forces annihilate Western Xia

properties.headline: 宋蒙联军蔡州灭金；宋军“端平入洛”溃败，宋蒙战争爆发
properties.headline_en: Song-Mongol forces destroy Jin at Caizhou; failed Duanping Expedition sparks Song-Mongol war

properties.headline: 窝阔台汗分兵三路全面伐宋，川陕、荆襄、江淮战火延烧
properties.headline_en: Ögedei Khan launches a three-pronged Mongol invasion across Sichuan, Jingxiang, and Jianghuai
properties.site: 襄阳 · 成都 · 阳平关

properties.headline: 凉州会盟：萨迦班智达与蒙古阔端会谈，吐蕃正式归附
properties.headline_en: Liangzhou Accord: Sakya Pandita meets Mongol prince Godan, bringing Tibet into the realm

properties.headline: 忽必烈率蒙军渡金沙江平定大理国
properties.headline_en: Kublai leads Mongol forces across the Jinsha River to conquer Dali

properties.headline: 钓鱼城之战，蒙哥汗战死城下
properties.headline_en: Siege of Diaoyu Fortress; Möngke Khan dies in campaign

properties.headline: 南宋权相贾似道于两浙强行推开“公田法”抑买民田，东南离心
properties.headline_en: Chancellor Jia Sidao enforces the Public Field Law in Zhexi, alienating Jiangnan landowners

properties.headline: 忽必烈设总制院（后改宣政院），统辖吐蕃政教事务
properties.headline_en: Kublai establishes the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs (Zongzhiyuan)

properties.headline: 忽必烈击败幼弟阿里不哥争位后，采《易经》“大哉乾元”改国号为大元
properties.headline_en: After defeating Ariq Böke in the succession war, Kublai Khan proclaims the Great Yuan at Dadu

properties.headline: 吕文焕力竭降元，襄阳苦守六年陷落
properties.headline_en: Xiangyang falls to the Yuan army after a six-year siege under Lü Wenhuan

properties.headline: 马可·波罗随元廷南返冬都大都，开启旅华十七载见闻
properties.headline_en: Marco Polo accompanies the Yuan court to the winter capital Dadu, beginning 17 years in China

properties.headline: 伯颜率元军入临安，恭帝出降；元置云南行中书省于中庆路
properties.headline_en: Bayan captures Lin'an, Emperor Gong surrenders; Yuan sets Yunnan Branch Secretariat at Zhongqing

properties.headline: 元军南下连陷闽广州郡，张世杰、陆秀夫奉宋端宗迁播广东碙洲
properties.headline_en: Yuan armies press into Fujian and Guangdong as Zhang Shijie and Lu Xiufu escort the court to sea

properties.headline: 陆秀夫等奉宋室退保闽广，崖山海战张世杰覆师，陆秀夫负帝投海宋亡
properties.headline_en: Retreating to Guangdong, Lu Xiufu leaps into the sea with child emperor Zhao Bing at Yashan

properties.headline: 张弘范于崖山海战灭南宋，元朝统一全国
properties.headline_en: Zhang Hongfan destroys the Southern Song fleet at the Battle of Yashan; Yuan reunifies China

properties.headline: 元廷置澎湖巡检司管辖澎湖与琉球，并第二次东征日本
properties.headline_en: Kublai Khan sets up Penghu Inspection Office over Penghu and Ryukyu and launches 2nd Japan raid

properties.headline: 元廷采纳朱清、张瑄议开辟江南刘家港至直沽海上漕运航线
properties.headline_en: The Yuan court inaugurates the sea grain transport route from Taicang north to Zhigu and Dadu

properties.headline: 忽必烈亲征平定辽东乃颜之乱，设辽阳行省
properties.headline_en: Kublai suppresses Nayan's revolt in Manchuria; Liaoyang Province established

properties.headline: 元廷设宣政院掌佛教与吐蕃事务，西藏纳入中央管辖
properties.headline_en: Yuan court establishes Xuanzheng Yuan, integrating Tibet into central imperial administration

properties.headline: 元世祖忽必烈命郭守敬开凿通惠河，京杭大运河全线贯通
properties.headline_en: Kublai Khan and Guo Shoujing open the Tonghui Canal, completing the Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal

properties.headline: 元成宗即位诏尊孔子、停征日本与安南，整饬吏治开启大德守成
properties.headline_en: Emperor Chengzong halts overseas campaigns, honors Confucius, and consolidates Yuan governance

properties.headline: 元武宗置和林行省（后改岭北行省），中书省与诸行省行政格局定型
properties.headline_en: Emperor Wuzong establishes Karakorum (Lingbei) Province, finalizing the provincial system

properties.headline: 元仁宗诏复科举，以程朱理学取士，延续至清末
properties.headline_en: Emperor Renzong restores the civil exams with Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucian canon as the standard

properties.headline: 南坡之变：铁失于上都南坡行帐弑元英宗与丞相拜住
properties.headline_en: Coup at Nanpo: Censor Tegshi assassinates reformist Emperor Yingzong and Chancellor Baiju

properties.headline: 两都之战（天历之变）：燕铁木儿拥元文宗击败上都天顺帝
properties.headline_en: War of the Two Capitals: El Temür enthrones Emperor Wenzong in Dadu and defeats Shangdu

properties.headline: 元顺帝任脱脱为相改弦更张，恢复科举并诏修宋、辽、金三史
properties.headline_en: Chancellor Toqto’a restores civil examinations and commissions the Song, Liao, and Jin histories

properties.headline: 黄河于曹县白茅堤大决口泛滥，元廷命贾鲁治河征发民夫
properties.headline_en: Yellow River breaches the Baimaodi dike at Caoxian; Jia Lu’s massive corvée sparks unrest

properties.headline: 韩山童、刘福通于颍州发动红巾军起义，徐寿辉于蕲水称帝建天完
properties.headline_en: Han Shantong and Liu Futong launch the Red Turban Rebellion at Yingzhou

properties.headline: 高邮之战：脱脱围张士诚，临阵被罢，元军百万溃散
properties.headline_en: Siege of Gaoyou: Toghto is dismissed while besieging Zhang Shicheng and the Yuan host collapses

properties.headline: 刘福通迎韩林儿于亳州称帝，建国号大宋（改元龙凤）
properties.headline_en: Liu Futong enthrones Han Lin'er at Bozhou as Emperor of Great Song (Longfeng era)

properties.headline: 朱元璋攻克集庆路改置应天府；张士诚渡江定都平江
properties.headline_en: Zhu Yuanzhang takes Jiqing and makes it Yingtianfu; Zhang Shicheng rules from Pingjiang

properties.headline: 红巾军三路北伐，中路关先生攻破上都，焚毁宫阙
properties.headline_en: Red Turban armies march north in three columns; the central column sacks and burns Shangdu

properties.headline: 陈友谅于采石杀徐寿辉称帝，建国号汉，率水师东攻应天败于龙湾
properties.headline_en: Chen Youliang kills Xu Shouhui at Caishi, proclaims Han, and is repelled at Longwan

properties.headline: 鄱阳湖水战朱元璋大败陈友谅；张士诚称吴王、明玉珍于重庆称帝建夏
properties.headline_en: Battle of Lake Poyang: Zhu Yuanzhang defeats Chen Youliang; Ming Yuzhen founds Xia

properties.headline: 朱元璋攻灭张士诚统一江南，命徐达、常遇春誓师北伐
properties.headline_en: Zhu Yuanzhang conquers Zhang Shicheng to unify Jiangnan and launches Xu Da’s Northern Expedition

properties.headline: 明大将军徐达、常遇春攻克大都，元顺帝北走上都，元亡
properties.headline_en: Ming generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun capture Dadu as Toghon Temur flees north, ending Yuan

properties.headline: 朱元璋于应天称帝建明；徐达北伐克大都，元廷北迁
properties.headline_en: Zhu Yuanzhang founds the Ming in Yingtian; Xu Da captures Dadu as Yuan retreats north

properties.headline: 常遇春克元上都，徐达定陕西，北元退居漠北
properties.headline_en: Chang Yuchun takes Shangdu and Xu Da secures Shaanxi as the Northern Yuan retreats north

properties.headline: 汤和、傅友德分道伐蜀，灭明夏政权平定四川
properties.headline_en: Tang He and Fu Youde conquer the Ming Xia regime to unify Sichuan

properties.headline: 明太祖兴胡惟庸案诛权臣，罢中书省、永废丞相制
properties.headline_en: Hongwu Emperor purges Chancellor Hu Weiyong and abolishes the Secretariat and chancellorship

properties.headline: 傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率军平定云南元梁王与大理段氏
properties.headline_en: Fu Youde, Lan Yu, and Mu Ying pacify the Yuan Prince of Liang and the Duan clan in Yunnan

properties.headline: 冯胜北征金山降纳哈出（1387年）；蓝玉捕鱼儿海破北元
properties.headline_en: Feng Sheng subdues Naghachu at Jinshan (1387); Lan Yu crushes the Northern Yuan at Lake Buir

properties.headline: 蓝玉案株连一万五千人，明初开国功臣宿将殆尽
properties.headline_en: Lan Yu Case purges 15,000 officials and generals, decimating Ming's founding military elite

properties.headline: 燕王朱棣于北平起兵发动“靖难之役”
properties.headline_en: Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, launches the Jingnan Campaign from Beiping

properties.headline: 靖难军破南京朱棣即位为明成祖，选解缙等入值文渊阁创内阁制
properties.headline_en: Jingnan forces take Nanjing; the Yongle Emperor ascends the throne and establishes the Cabinet

properties.headline: 郑和率宝船队自刘家港首次下西洋
properties.headline_en: Zheng He embarks on his first treasure fleet voyage from Liujiagang

properties.headline: 明军平安南设交趾布政司；1409年设奴儿干都司
properties.headline_en: Yongle Emperor establishes Jiaozhi Province in Annam and founds the Nurgan Commandery in 1409

properties.headline: 解缙、姚广孝等历时五年编成《永乐大典》二万二千八百余卷
properties.headline_en: Xie Jin and Yao Guangxiao complete the 22,877-scroll Yongle Encyclopedia in Nanjing

properties.headline: 明成祖废思州、思南宣慰司，置贵州承宣布政使司定十三行省
properties.headline_en: Yongle Emperor establishes Guizhou Province, completing the Ming thirteen-province system

properties.headline: 明成祖迁都北京，以南京为留都；1420年设东厂，与锦衣卫称厂卫
properties.headline_en: Yongle moves the capital to Beijing; the Eastern Depot (1420) joins the Embroidered Guard

properties.headline: 明宣宗罢交趾布政使司撤军弃安南，黎利旋建后黎朝
properties.headline_en: Emperor Xuanzong abolishes Jiaozhi and withdraws from Vietnam; Le Loi soon founds the Later Le

properties.headline: 郑和末次下西洋，此后海禁
properties.headline_en: Zheng He's seventh and final voyage; maritime restrictions follow

properties.headline: 明廷始筑辽东边墙，防御朵颜三卫与女真
properties.headline_en: Ming begins constructing the Liaodong Wall to defend the northeast

properties.headline: 土木堡之变：瓦剌也先大破明军，俘明英宗
properties.headline_en: Tumu Crisis: Oirat leader Esen routs the Ming army and captures Emperor Yingzong

properties.headline: 夺门之变：石亨、徐有贞迎明英宗自南宫复辟，于谦遇害
properties.headline_en: Wresting the Gate Coup: Shi Heng and Xu Youzhen restore Emperor Yingzong and execute Yu Qian

properties.headline: 余子俊奏筑延绥边墙，明代九边长城防线成型
properties.headline_en: Yu Zijun constructs the 1,700-li Yansui Wall, shaping the Ming Nine Garrisons Great Wall

properties.headline: 汪直、朱永会同朝鲜征建州女真，史称“成化犁庭”
properties.headline_en: Wang Zhi and Zhu Yong join Joseon forces against the Jianzhou Jurchens in the Chenghua Campaign

properties.headline: 刘大夏于黄陵岗塞河筑太行堤，断黄河北流成“河夺淮”定局
properties.headline_en: Liu Daxia seals the Huanglinggang breach and builds the Taihang Dike, fixing the Yellow-Huai

properties.headline: 王守仁贬谪贵州修文“龙场悟道”，创立知行合一心学
properties.headline_en: Wang Yangming attains enlightenment at Longchang in Guizhou, founding the School of Mind

properties.headline: 吐鲁番满速儿攻占哈密卫，关西诸卫渐次内迁
properties.headline_en: Mansur of Turpan seizes Hami Guard; the Ming guards west of Jiayuguan gradually withdraw

properties.headline: 王阳明督兵三十五日平定江西南昌宁王朱宸濠之乱
properties.headline_en: Wang Yangming suppresses the Prince of Ning (Zhu Chenhao) Rebellion at Nanchang in 35 days

properties.headline: 大礼议之争：嘉靖帝于左顺门廷杖百官，皇权压倒内阁
properties.headline_en: Great Rites Controversy: Jiajing Emperor flogs protesting officials at Left Shun Gate

properties.headline: 壬寅宫变：杨金英等宫女谋缢嘉靖帝未遂，帝移居西苑
properties.headline_en: RenYin Palace Rebellion: palace women led by Yang Jinying fail to strangle the Jiajing Emperor

properties.headline: 庚戌之变：鞑靼俺答汗因请开贡市遭拒，率骑破古北口兵临北京城下
properties.headline_en: Gengxu Incident: refused border trade, Altan Khan breaches Gubeikou and besieges Beijing

properties.headline: 戚继光率戚家军九战九捷，平定台州倭患
properties.headline_en: Qi Jiguang wins nine straight victories at Taizhou, crushing Japanese pirates

properties.headline: 明廷实行“隆庆开关”，于福建漳州月港开放海外贸易
properties.headline_en: Longqing Emperor lifts the maritime trade ban at Yuegang in Fujian (the Longqing Opening)

properties.headline: 隆庆和议：明廷封俺答汗为顺义王，于大同得胜堡开互市
properties.headline_en: Longqing Peace Accord: Ming invests Altan Khan as Prince Shunyi and opens Datong horse markets

properties.headline: 张居正清丈全国田亩，推行“一条鞭法”
properties.headline_en: Zhang Juzheng implements the Single Whip Law tax reform

properties.headline: 万历朝鲜之役：明军入朝抗击丰臣秀吉日军
properties.headline_en: Imjin War: Ming dispatches forces to aid Joseon against Toyotomi Hideyoshi

properties.headline: 李化龙平定播州杨应龙之乱，“改土归流”分置遵义、平越二府
properties.headline_en: Ming forces crush the Bozhou Tusi rebellion, replacing hereditary rule with two prefectures

properties.headline: 努尔哈赤于赫图阿拉称汗，建立后金
properties.headline_en: Nurhaci proclaims himself Khan of Later Jin at Hetu Ala in Manchuria

properties.headline: 萨尔浒之战：努尔哈赤各个击破明军四路大军
properties.headline_en: Battle of Sarhū: Nurhaci defeats the four Ming expeditionary columns piecemeal

properties.headline: 沈辽之战：努尔哈赤连克沈阳、辽阳，后金迁都辽阳
properties.headline_en: Battle of Shen-Liao: Nurhaci captures Shenyang and Liaoyang, moving the Later Jin capital

properties.headline: 杨涟疏参魏忠贤二十四大罪，阉党兴诏狱残害东林党人，朝政糜烂
properties.headline_en: Yang Lian impeaches Wei Zhongxian for 24 crimes, sparking a purge of Donglin scholars

properties.headline: 宁远大捷：袁崇焕凭孤城红夷大炮重创后金努尔哈赤
properties.headline_en: Victory at Ningyuan: Yuan Chonghuan repels Nurhaci's Later Jin siege with heavy cannon

properties.headline: 澄城王二起事，陕北民变揭开明末农民战争序幕
properties.headline_en: Wang Er rises at Chengcheng; Shaanxi peasant revolts open the late-Ming rebellions

properties.headline: 皇太极在盛京称帝，改国号“大清”
properties.headline_en: Hong Taiji proclaims the Great Qing dynasty at Shengjing (Mukden)

properties.headline: 松锦大战：皇太极围点打援击溃洪承畴十三万明军，关外防线尽失
properties.headline_en: Hong Taiji crushes Hong Chengchou’s 130,000 Ming troops at Song-Jin outside Shanhaiguan

properties.headline: 李自成破潼关入西安，张献忠据武昌称大西王
properties.headline_en: Li Zicheng breaks through Tongguan into Xi'an; Zhang Xianzhong holds Wuchang as King of Daxi

properties.headline: 李自成破北京，明亡；清军入关
properties.headline_en: Li Zicheng takes Beijing and topples the Ming; Qing armies enter Shanhai Pass

properties.headline: 山海关总兵吴三桂降清开关，多尔衮率清军大败李自成大顺军，定都北京
properties.headline_en: Wu Sangui opens Shanhai Pass to Dorgon’s Qing army, which routs Li Zicheng and takes Beijing

properties.headline: 清军破扬州、南京，弘光政权覆灭；颁剃发令，江南抗清
properties.headline_en: Qing armies take Yangzhou and Nanjing, ending the Hongguang court; the queue edict sparks revolt

properties.headline: 郑成功横渡鹿耳门驱逐荷兰殖民者，收复台湾设承天府
properties.headline_en: Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) expels the Dutch and establishes Tungning on Taiwan

properties.headline: 吴三桂于昆明杀南明永历帝，李定国病逝，南明大陆抗清终结
properties.headline_en: Wu Sangui executes the Southern Ming Yongli Emperor in Kunming; Prince Li Dingguo dies

properties.headline: 少年康熙帝于武英殿智擒专权辅臣鳌拜，正式亲政
properties.headline_en: Young Kangxi Emperor seizes regent Oboi at Wuying Hall to assume personal rule

properties.headline: 康熙帝下旨撤藩，吴三桂于云南起兵反清，三藩之乱爆发
properties.headline_en: Kangxi orders abolition of the feudatories; Wu Sangui rebels in Yunnan (Three Feudatories)

properties.headline: 清军攻克昆明，康熙帝彻底平定三藩之乱
properties.headline_en: Qing forces capture Kunming as Kangxi Emperor fully quells Three Feudatories

properties.headline: 康熙帝命施琅于澎湖大破明郑水师，郑克塽出降，清廷设台湾府
properties.headline_en: Kangxi Emperor sends Admiral Shi Lang to take Penghu; Zheng Keshuang yields and Taiwanfu is set

properties.headline: 康熙命彭春、萨布素发起雅克萨之战，痛击沙俄侵略军
properties.headline_en: Kangxi orders the Siege of Albazin (Yakesa) against Russian Cossack incursions

properties.headline: 康熙帝遣索额图与沙俄订立《尼布楚条约》，划定中俄东段边界
properties.headline_en: Kangxi Emperor's envoys sign the Treaty of Nerchinsk, defining the eastern Sino-Russian border

properties.headline: 多伦会盟，喀尔喀蒙古内附
properties.headline_en: Dolon Nor Assembly brings the Khalkha Mongols into the Qing realm

properties.headline: 康熙帝三次亲征漠北，昭莫多之战大破准噶尔部噶尔丹主力
properties.headline_en: Emperor Kangxi personally leads campaigns into Outer Mongolia, routing Galdan at Jao Modo

properties.headline: 康熙帝遣清军驱逐准噶尔军，护送七世达赖入藏，西藏定局
properties.headline_en: Kangxi Emperor sends Qing forces to expel Dzungars from Lhasa and install the 7th Dalai Lama

properties.headline: 康熙帝卒，雍正帝即位，开启摊丁入亩与西南改土归流
properties.headline_en: Kangxi dies; Yongzheng Emperor ascends, launching tax and southwest reforms

properties.headline: 年羹尧平青海罗卜藏丹津
properties.headline_en: Nian Gengyao suppresses Lobzang Danjin’s revolt in Qinghai

properties.headline: 清廷始设驻藏大臣督办藏务；中俄签订《恰克图条约》
properties.headline_en: Yongzheng Emperor establishes Imperial Resident in Tibet; Qing and Russia sign Treaty of Kyakhta

properties.headline: 雍正帝设军机房（后称军机处），皇权空前集中
properties.headline_en: Emperor Yongzheng creates the Grand Council, concentrating state power in the throne

properties.headline: 乾隆帝即位，设办理苗疆事务、经略西北准部
properties.headline_en: Qianlong Emperor ascends; northwest campaigns prepared

properties.headline: 乾隆帝命清军两路出师西域直抵伊犁，攻灭准噶尔汗国并俘达瓦齐
properties.headline_en: Qianlong Emperor sends two Qing columns to Ili, destroying the Dzungar Khanate and Dawachi

properties.headline: 乾隆帝限令西洋商船只许广州一口通商，十三行专营
properties.headline_en: Qianlong confines Western trade to Canton under the Thirteen Hongs (the Canton System)

properties.headline: 清军平定准噶尔与大小和卓，统合西域并设伊犁将军
properties.headline_en: Qianlong Emperor pacifies the Dzungars and Altishahr Khojas, establishing the General of Ili

properties.headline: 渥巴锡率土尔扈特部自伏尔加河万里东归
properties.headline_en: Torghut Mongols under Ubashi Khan return from the Volga to Ili

properties.headline: 乾隆帝开四库全书馆编纂《四库全书》，同时借修书屡兴文字狱
properties.headline_en: The Qianlong Emperor commissions the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries and purges texts

properties.headline: 福康安率军渡海平定台湾林爽文起义，乾隆赐改诸罗县为“嘉义”
properties.headline_en: Fuk'anggan suppresses Lin Shuangwen in Taiwan; Qianlong renames Zhuluo to Jiayi

properties.headline: 福康安击退廓尔喀，颁《钦定藏内善后章程》与金瓶掣签制
properties.headline_en: Fuk'anggan repels Gorkhas; 29-Article Ordinance and Golden Urn instituted

properties.headline: 英使马戛尔尼于承德觐见乾隆帝请开商埠遭拒
properties.headline_en: British envoy Lord Macartney meets the Qianlong Emperor at Chengde; trade demands refused

properties.headline: 太上皇乾隆禅位嘉庆帝；川楚白莲教起义爆发
properties.headline_en: Qianlong abdicates to Jiaqing; White Lotus Rebellion breaks out

properties.headline: 乾隆崩后嘉庆帝亲政，迅雷赐死贪墨权臣和珅，清廷由盛转衰
properties.headline_en: Upon Qianlong’s death, the Jiaqing Emperor assumes personal rule and executes Heshen

properties.headline: 癸酉之变：天理教林清攻入紫禁城隆宗门，皇子绵宁御敌
properties.headline_en: Guiyou Incident: Lin Qing’s rebels storm the Forbidden City to Longzong Gate and are repelled

properties.headline: 张格尔之乱攻陷喀什噶尔，长龄率军西征平定
properties.headline_en: Jahangir Khoja seizes Kashgar; General Changling marches west and restores Qing rule

properties.headline: 林则徐于广东虎门海滩当众销毁鸦片两万余箱，虎门销烟
properties.headline_en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu destroys over 20,000 chests of opium at Humen in Guangdong

properties.headline: 英军封锁珠江口北犯，第一次鸦片战争爆发
properties.headline_en: British fleet blockades the Pearl River estuary, sparking the First Opium War

properties.headline: 《南京条约》签订：割让香港岛，开五口通商
properties.headline_en: The Treaty of Nanjing cedes Hong Kong Island and opens five treaty ports to British trade

properties.headline: 洪秀全发动太平天国金田起义（1853年定都天京，据长江中下游）
properties.headline_en: Hong Xiuquan launches the Jintian Uprising, founding the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom

properties.headline: 黄河于兰阳铜瓦厢决口夺大清河入渤海，奠定现代走向
properties.headline_en: Yellow River breaches at Tongwaxiang, shifting north into the Bohai Sea along its modern path

properties.headline: 天京事变：杨韦内讧血洗天京，石达开出走，太平天国转衰
properties.headline_en: Tianjing Incident: internal purge shatters Taiping leadership; Shi Dakai departs Tianjing

properties.headline: 沙俄迫签《瑷珲条约》，割占黑龙江以北外兴安岭以南
properties.headline_en: Treaty of Aigun cedes territory north of the Amur River to Russia

properties.headline: 英法联军攻占北京、火烧圆明园；签《北京条约》割外东北
properties.headline_en: Anglo-French forces sack the Old Summer Palace; Convention of Peking cedes Outer Manchuria

properties.headline: 辛酉政变：慈禧、慈安联结恭亲王奕訢诛肃顺等八大臣垂帘
properties.headline_en: Xinyou Coup: Cixi, Ci’an, and Prince Gong oust Sushun’s Eight Regents to begin the Regency

properties.headline: 湘军攻陷天京，太平天国覆灭；沙俄迫签《勘分西北界约记》
properties.headline_en: Xiang Army captures Tianjing, ending Taiping Heavenly Kingdom; Russia annexes outer northwest

properties.headline: 曾国藩、李鸿章创办江南制造总局，洋务运动兴起
properties.headline_en: Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang found the Jiangnan Arsenal as Self-Strengthening takes off

properties.headline: 左宗棠抬棺西征平定阿古柏，收复新疆（1884年建省）
properties.headline_en: Zuo Zongtang reconquers Xinjiang from Yaqub Beg (Xinjiang Province in 1884)

properties.headline: 曾纪泽使俄订立《中俄伊犁条约》，收复伊犁九城大部
properties.headline_en: Zeng Jize signs the Treaty of Ili with Russia, recovering most of the Nine Cities of Ili

properties.headline: 老将冯子材率军于镇南关大捷重创法军并克谅山，扭转中法战局
properties.headline_en: Battle of Zhennan Pass: General Feng Zicai routs French forces and recaptures Lang Son

properties.headline: 台湾正式建省，刘铭传任首任巡抚，筑铁路、设电报
properties.headline_en: Taiwan becomes a full province under Governor Liu Mingchuan, who builds railways and telegraphs

properties.headline: 甲午战争爆发；黄海海战邓世昌驾“致远”舰壮烈殉国
properties.headline_en: First Sino-Japanese War breaks out; Deng Shichang perishes ramming the enemy in Yellow Sea

properties.headline: 清廷甲午战败，遣李鸿章赴日签订《马关条约》，割让台湾、澎湖
properties.headline_en: Defeated by Japan, Qing sends Li Hongzhang to sign the Treaty of Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan

properties.headline: 百日维新与戊戌政变慈禧囚光绪；列强强租胶州湾、旅大与新界
properties.headline_en: Hundred Days’ Reform ends in Wuxu Coup; powers lease Jiaozhou Bay, Dalian, and New Territories

properties.headline: 八国联军占北京，慈禧挟光绪奔西安；东南督抚行东南互保
properties.headline_en: Eight-Nation Alliance occupies Beijing as Cixi flees to Xi’an; southern governors keep peace

properties.headline: 清廷命奕劻、李鸿章与十一国签订《辛丑条约》，赔款四亿五千万两
properties.headline_en: Yikuang and Li Hongzhang sign the Boxer Protocol with 11 powers (450M-tael indemnity)

properties.headline: 清廷废除科举，延续一千三百年的取士制度终结
properties.headline_en: The Qing court abolishes the imperial examinations, ending a 1,300-year institution

properties.headline: 清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》行预备立宪；光绪帝与慈禧太后相继崩逝
properties.headline_en: The Qing court issues the Outline of Imperial Constitution; Guangxu and Cixi die within days

properties.headline: 武昌起义爆发，各省响应开启辛亥革命
properties.headline_en: Wuchang Uprising erupts and sparks the nationwide Xinhai Revolution

properties.headline: 孙中山于南京就职建中华民国；清帝溥仪退位，二千年帝制终结
properties.headline_en: Sun Yat-sen founds the Republic of China in Nanjing; Puyi abdicates, ending imperial rule

properties.headline: 蔡锷在云南起义，发起讨袁护国战争
properties.headline_en: Cai E launches the National Protection War in Yunnan against Yuan Shikai

properties.headline: 袁世凯病逝，北洋集团分裂为皖、直、奉系，南北军阀割据
properties.headline_en: Yuan Shikai dies; the Beiyang bloc fractures into Anhui, Zhili, and Fengtian warlord cliques

properties.headline: 巴黎和会外交失利，北京爆发五四运动
properties.headline_en: May Fourth Movement erupts in Beijing over the Treaty of Versailles

properties.headline: 直皖战争爆发，曹锟、吴佩孚直系击败段祺瑞皖系控制北京
properties.headline_en: Zhili–Anhui War: Cao Kun and Wu Peifu defeat Duan Qirui's Anhui Clique to seize Beijing

properties.headline: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会召开
properties.headline_en: First National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

properties.headline: 国共第一次合作，黄埔军校在广州创办
properties.headline_en: First KMT-CCP United Front; Whampoa Military Academy founded

properties.headline: 国民革命军自广州誓师北伐，攻克武昌、南昌
properties.headline_en: National Revolutionary Army launches the Northern Expedition

properties.headline: 国民革命军北伐完成，张学良东北易帜，南京国民政府形式统一
properties.headline_en: NRA completes the Northern Expedition; Zhang Xueliang's Flag Replacement nominally unifies China

properties.headline: 日本关东军袭占沈阳，发动九一八事变
properties.headline_en: Mukden Incident (Sept 18): Kwantung Army seizes Shenyang and occupies Manchuria

properties.headline: 日本扶植溥仪在长春建伪“满洲国”，东北沦陷十四载
properties.headline_en: Japan installs Puyi in Changchun as head of puppet Manchukuo, occupying Northeast China

properties.headline: 红军长征途中召开遵义会议，次年会师陕甘
properties.headline_en: Zunyi Conference held during the Long March

properties.headline: 张学良、杨虎城发动西安事变，促成联共抗日
properties.headline_en: Xi'an Incident leads to the Second United Front against Japan
